So, is it "ADD-land"? Or is it "AHHD-land"? Or what?

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

## _**[Saving Nine](https://ct.klclick.com/f/a/Tj1jpcWhdgNyg57G8cX7Vw~~/AASl5QA~/RgRkgpX-P0SBaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY2VudGVyc3RyZWV0LmNvbS90aXRsZXMvbWlrZS1sZWUvc2F2aW5nLW5pbmUvOTc4MTU0NjAwMjIwOC8_X2t4PVBkTVpmNU50ZkF6YjdES1M2Y2dBRkw2dElzamMzVDNDN2xDeFpqbWE1alElM0QuSnpSY1VLVwNzcGNCCmKa_hCgYjslwcpSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAA2P3)**_
The Supreme Court in under attack. Leftist in Congress with the support of Joe Biden have created a committee to examine reforms to the Supreme Court. These reforms include court-packing; adding additional seats to the Court and thus allowing it to become another partisan weapon. In [**_Saving Nine_**](https://ct.klclick.com/f/a/Tj1jpcWhdgNyg57G8cX7Vw~~/AASl5QA~/RgRkgpX-P0SBaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY2VudGVyc3RyZWV0LmNvbS90aXRsZXMvbWlrZS1sZWUvc2F2aW5nLW5pbmUvOTc4MTU0NjAwMjIwOC8_X2t4PVBkTVpmNU50ZkF6YjdES1M2Y2dBRkw2dElzamMzVDNDN2xDeFpqbWE1alElM0QuSnpSY1VLVwNzcGNCCmKa_hCgYjslwcpSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAA2P3), Senator Mike Lee, a respected member of the Senate Judiciary Committee reveals the leftist plans for the Supreme Court and the dangers they pose for our nation. _**[Saving Nine](https://ct.klclick.com/f/a/Tj1jpcWhdgNyg57G8cX7Vw~~/AASl5QA~/RgRkgpX-P0SBaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY2VudGVyc3RyZWV0LmNvbS90aXRsZXMvbWlrZS1sZWUvc2F2aW5nLW5pbmUvOTc4MTU0NjAwMjIwOC8_X2t4PVBkTVpmNU50ZkF6YjdES1M2Y2dBRkw2dElzamMzVDNDN2xDeFpqbWE1alElM0QuSnpSY1VLVwNzcGNCCmKa_hCgYjslwcpSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAA2P3)**_ is a must read for all those interested in preserving an independent judiciary!

| | |
---
|
### About the Book:
It wasn’t long ago that liberal icons, including the late Supreme Court Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg, were against the idea of overhauling the court for political gain. But now, in the Biden era, more and more powerful Democrats are getting behind the cause, claiming the high court is broken and actively dismantling our democracy. Even Joe Biden—who once called court-packing a “bonehead idea”—gave in to the progressive wing of his party.
---
| |
---
|
### About the Author:
Mike Lee is a United States senator from Utah and a member of the Senate Judiciary Committee. Lee’s interest in the Supreme Court began when he was only ten years old and his father, the late Rex Edwin Lee—then serving as President Ronald Reagan’s solicitor general—started bringing the future senator with him when he argued cases before the Court. After graduating from law school, Lee served as a law clerk to Associate Justice Samuel A. Alito, Jr., first on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit, and then on the Supreme Court. Before entering politics, Lee served as an assistant U.S. attorney and later as general counsel to Utah Governor Jon M. Huntsman, Jr. During his years in private practice, he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Lee, a New York Times bestselling author, has written several books on American political and legal history.

name: Andy Ngo
subject: We can’t let them get away with this…
body:
The mob was angry and looking for a fight.

|
Peter,

I was one of the first civilians savagely beaten by lawless Antifa thugs.

And unless we do something to stop them today, I'll be far from the last.

[**That's why I'm asking you to donate $35 or more today to help me fund my landmark lawsuit that will bring Antifa and their members to justice.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60539386:J1vjI_ooN:m:1:3317145305:6854FD770C016C70BF7BCA85AF91C28B:r)

**You see, I was at Antifa's "ground zero" in the summer of 2019.**

This was before most Americans had ever heard of the Antifa movement, but they'd caused havoc before.

I went to an Antifa "protest" as a journalist, to document and report on the event.

As soon as I arrived, I feared for my safety.

The mob was angry and looking for a fight.

Most of them wore masks -- and not the kind we're forced today because of coronavirus. They wanted to act like criminals without getting caught. Many had on helmets and makeshift armor. Some carried weapons like metal pipes, chains, crowbars, and even bricks.

I was scared, but I had a job to do, so I pressed on.

**People like you needed to know what was happening.**

But I didn't go unnoticed for long.

Somebody recognized me and jeers quickly rose through the crowd.

"F*** you, Andy Ngo!" and "Go home, fascist!"

I tried to escape, but it was too late.

**Projectiles started flying. Then came the fists.**

Before I knew it, I was being punched, kicked, and hit with flying objects.

I tried to protect my head, but I did not strike back as I knew that would only escalate the situation and put me in more danger.

Not to mention they stole my camera.

What they did to me is unacceptable. But this last summer, it became much worse than I could've ever imagined as Antifa set fire to entire cities for weeks on end.

**And now, we're watching Antifa and similar groups threaten mass riots and violence across the country.**

[**Will you donate $35 or more to help me cover the costs of my lawsuit against Antifa?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60539386:J1vjI_ooN:m:1:3317145305:6854FD770C016C70BF7BCA85AF91C28B:r)

This is bigger than me alone.

You see, after I got away from the mob, police finally showed up to question me, but my attackers stole all my evidence.

Later, cell phone footage from a bystander surfaced online. Thank goodness! The video captured the attack, clear as day.

I hoped I'd get the justice I deserved.

Wrong.

To this day, over a year later, my attackers are walking free. Portland police did nothing.

No charges.

No convictions

No justice.

It's not much of a surprise, though.

You see, radical politicians have long-since bowed to the dangerous mob that terrorizes their streets.

And now, as you and I are watching Antifa's nationwide takeover, more and more politicians across the country are following suit.

It's so bad that the justice system is buckling under the pressure of threats of violence from these disgusting thugs.

We have to stop them and make them face real, legal consequences for their destructive actions before they get to you and your family.

[**That's why I hope you'll join in the fight by donating $35 or more to fund my landmark lawsuit against Antifa and their members.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60539386:J1vjI_ooN:m:1:3317145305:6854FD770C016C70BF7BCA85AF91C28B:r)

Because Antifa wants the end of America as we know it -- and they'll stop at nothing to get it. Believe me when I say that's not an overstatement.

Some members are avowed socialists or communists. But many are much worse - open anarchists who want to tear down our society and remake it in their own twisted vision.

By any means necessary.

**_Rioting. Destruction. Mayhem._**

And they know, as long as they choose politically favored protests to co-opt, the media and politicians will never have the guts to denounce their violence or hold them accountable.

It's a sick strategy, but very smart - because so far, they've been right!

**For the most part, they've gotten off scot-free. **

Our politicians and media are treating this deranged terrorist group like peaceful protestors!

As we've seen, their riots will only spread and intensify if Antifa continues to escape consequences.

**So now I'm taking justice into my own hands - with the help of the talented lawyers at the Center for American Liberty.**

And, as I mentioned, we're suing Portland's Antifa Chapter. We've made a lot of progress in this case, but we're far from victory.

[**You can be a part of bringing Antifa to justice with a donation of $35 or more today.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60539386:J1vjI_ooN:m:1:3317145305:6854FD770C016C70BF7BCA85AF91C28B:r)

Though I'm seeking justice for myself, the impact of this case could be so much larger.

This is about standing up for our country when our own leaders won't. This is about saving America as we know it and keeping you and your family safe.

And this is just the first blow we intend to deliver.

By taking them to court for the attack against me we can prove they are NOT untouchable.

[**Can I count on you to donate $35 or more to fund this critical lawsuit?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60539386:J1vjI_ooN:m:1:3317145305:6854FD770C016C70BF7BCA85AF91C28B:r)

Please don't wait - if we don't fight back and win now, these violent thugs will be in EVERY city across America, destroying everything and everyone in their path.

Thank you in advance for your support.

**Sincerely,**
**Andy Ngo**

body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?”
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zfiuchbncjbf7486fvpt7950el9luqotto2vtoao_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37c9l6cqj7djl6eqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbon1ppj6pg76d36m6om8oth6eqm8slks2oecttgshqj9o3gckor0ormcpqn6chgcv970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj666rjbcr7mth6cdb2mdi3fc5lclp238h1e8he4933clgm6o72c5j6aoh5u)
| | | This sponsored message from American Defense News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z5q4a2essoo715s9s5a9nfji05878n07uqaj26mo_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cdge4ob6clh2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York_ magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z3vuc1246n8vs7juapoikm4p1ve0honul6lpkp20_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cdge4ob6clh2bs)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages.** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly.** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism** in the next five days**,** your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zhb67t2pviltlc1kmc5eusbohm8fb5dd3d2ea34g_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cdge4ob6clh2bs)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Great America Update
subject: Is socialism on the rise?
body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6026%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=RBK3Zr%2fdF8%2bSF7Rkgvl%2bFA&sysid=1)
| | | This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62141%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=3r5iFUU7uyesBUnqeeX5kg&sysid=1)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty--author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’--a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for--and opposition to--socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62142%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=BSVZx%2fmfNtxEtjwqWwKrdQ&sysid=1)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”--including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory--which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race--are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62142%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=BSVZx%2fmfNtxEtjwqWwKrdQ&sysid=1)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember--**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

body:

[View this message in your browser](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zog3drigvf5qgacs3rpocm13lt4g22k22mkg7ft8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jksrr0s3iekr79c9l6eon9d1hmej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf9pr2cgqrasdm6ooj8p3geer3ep77ciqm4t366com6olhegrb6c9ie9r64sb761jt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or0e8q6cc9n6kpmfdj0coo71cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn48d245p25oh4cdim2or0sdg60pj24no)
| | | Socialism is infiltrating our school system nationwide and our children are being influenced to adopt radical beliefs that could destroy our culture and our Republic. Fortunately, I believe there is a solution that could help turn the tide, educate our country’s youth against the dangers of socialism, and teach young people about the ideas of liberty. My personal friend Connor Boyack is the author of the Tuttle Twins, a series of children’s books teaching kids about free markets, private property rights, the Constitution, and the ideas of our Founding Fathers. _He is on a mission to distribute an additional 1,000,000 copies of the books into the hands of homeschool families, public schools, and libraries. _
---
---
Connor helped me get elected back in 2010. Since then, he founded the Libertas Institute, a free market think tank headquartered in our home state, Utah. Connor was inspired to write the Tuttle Twins series when he was unable to find a way to teach his own kids about the ideas of freedom. So far, Connor has distributed over 2 million copies of the Tuttle Twins to families and children across the country. **Connor is leading the fight against socialist indoctrination in our schools creating a new generation of young people who love the ideas of liberty and our country. ** [**Here is how Connor and the Libertas Institute plan to distribute 1,000,000 new copies of the Tuttle Twins:**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z94l5in5hufiivsgf1fo5oi32u9kdaa3ksk9rnkg_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cdge6o30cph2bs)
---
1. Homeschool children and parents actively teaching their kids about the ideas of freedom and U.S. history will receive copies for education at home.

2. The Libertas Institute then plans to place tens of thousands of copies in public schools and libraries to give kids an alternative to the dangerous ideas of socialism.

3. In order to do this, we must raise funds to print and distribute these books. [**It costs roughly $10 to produce and ship each book.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zknjb8fpj679jd6jf3u0uhtdhi9es63sf5qhfh4o_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cdge6o30cph2bs)

---
**The reality is neither Rand Paul, Ted Cruz, nor myself can defeat socialism alone... we need a new generation of young conservatives willing to stand up for the Constitution and our freedoms.** You and I can help save the younger generation from socialism by supplying these children and their families the Tuttle Twins books! **I spoke with Connor Boyack, the President of the Libertas Institute and author of the books, and gave him my word I would help him raise $20,000 to fund distribution of the Tuttle Twins books to homeschool children, parents, and kids in public schools. **_**Please consider donating the most generous amount you can to help put a Tuttle Twins book in the hands of a young child****! **_
---
***PLEASE NOTE: All online donations are being matched by one of the Libertas Institute’s biggest supporters, John P. ****This means your donation is DOUBLED! If you donate $100, John will personally match it with another $100 gift****.*** [**Donate 1 Tuttle Twins book for $10 Here >>>**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zmu1a3tbld0bspc8v89abdgm8spa63gh475i0i3o_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cdge6o30cph2bs) [**Donate 2 Tuttle Twins book for $20 Here >>>**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zcrclio560jm048br126l1di5vssq53pu6ie62p0_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cdge6o30cph2bs) [**Donate 5 Tuttle Twins book for $50 Here >>>**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zstgd9no7f79titl8g5650a0j2ilbj4ct3onrd28_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cdge6o30cph2bs) [**Donate 10 Tuttle Twins book for $100 Here >>>**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zam6bekbft0o5ecpdcg4bden0c6ko95uesmg5r78_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cdge6o30cph2bs) [**Donate 25 Tuttle Twins book for $250 Here >>>**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zjgrol6a5bau4sb4cmm661c6ghs5hhtal839cd50_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cdge6o30cph2bs) [**Donate 50 Tuttle Twins book for $500 Here >>>**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zk7c7j2c61npjon5eisq9rhckj1rr86udjk1a358_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cdge6o30cph2bs) [**Donate 100 Tuttle Twins book for $1,000 Here >>>**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zgqk5vagsnna1miq2vukq9q7gf7buf135igpoje0_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cdge6o30cph2bs) [**Donate Any Amount Here >>>**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z7tsc6otbde5dpbkn43raaonfups61uak87038j0_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cdge6o30cph2bs)
---
The best part about the Tuttle Twins? Kids actually enjoy reading them. Parents aren’t forcing their kids to read them. They are written for children to enjoy and learn at the same time. **This is the most promising path to save our kids from indoctrination and the dangers of socialism. You and I can create a new generation of young conservatives to preserve our Republic. **As I said, Connor is a great friend of mine and I believe in what he is doing. The Libertas Institute and the Tuttle Twins are transforming this country and is one of our most promising ways to fight back against socialism in schools. [**Please help me raise $20,000 in the next 48 hours by clicking here to make a donation and distribute copies of the Tuttle Twins to thousands of kids across the country! **](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z71tgq3g4tftq9cdck074f5vuv5tf2lfde95mqg0_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cdge6o30cph2bs) I suspect you get a dozen emails asking you to donate every week. This is much different. This isn’t for some campaign or candidate that needs money. This is a cause I am passionate about and believe can reverse the influence of socialism in our society. We just need to distribute these books and begin teaching our nation’s youth about the ideas of freedom and U.S. history. It seems like you love our country, the ideas of liberty, and the Constitution as much as I do. Which is why I am emailing you. Please consider making the most generous donation you can and help me restore our Republic.Please consider this a personal and urgent request from me. [**Here is the link to donate again.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zs3l41qocof726jaj8j4u3ps8jtce8ftl7nnls2o_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cdge6o30cph2bs)

Since then, he founded the Libertas Institute, a free market think tank headquartered in our home state, Utah. Connor was inspired to write the Tuttle Twins series when he was unable to find a way to teach his own kids about the ideas of freedom. So far, Connor has distributed over 2 million copies of the Tuttle Twins to families and children across the country. Connor is leading the fight against socialist indoctrination in our schools creating a new generation of young people who love the ideas of liberty and our country. 1. Homeschool children and parents actively teaching their kids about the ideas of freedom and U.S. history will receive copies for education at home. 2. The Libertas Institute then plans to place tens of thousands of copies in public schools and libraries to give kids an alternative to the dangerous ideas of socialism. 3. In order to do this, we must raise funds to print and distribute these books. The reality is neither Rand Paul, Ted Cruz, nor myself can defeat socialism alone... we need a new generation of young conservatives willing to stand up for the Constitution and our freedoms. You and I can help save the younger generation from socialism by supplying these children and their families the Tuttle Twins books! I spoke with Connor Boyack, the President of the Libertas Institute and author of the books, and gave him my word I would help him raise $20,000 to fund distribution of the Tuttle Twins books to homeschool children, parents, and kids in public schools. Please consider donating the most generous amount you can to help put a Tuttle Twins book in the hands of a young child! *PLEASE NOTE: All online donations are being matched by one of the Libertas Institute’s biggest supporters, John P. This means your donation is DOUBLED! If you donate $100, John will personally match it with another $100 gift. The best part about the Tuttle Twins? Kids actually enjoy reading them. Parents aren’t forcing their kids to read them. They are written for children to enjoy and learn at the same time. This is the most promising path to save our kids from indoctrination and the dangers of socialism. You and I can create a new generation of young conservatives to preserve our Republic. **As I said, Connor is a great friend of mine and I believe in what he is doing. The Libertas Institute and the Tuttle Twins are transforming this country and is one of our most promising ways to fight back against socialism in schools. I suspect you get a dozen emails asking you to donate every week. This is much different. This isn’t for some campaign or candidate that needs money. This is a cause I am passionate about and believe can reverse the influence of socialism in our society. We just need to distribute these books and begin teaching our nation’s youth about the ideas of freedom and U.S. history. It seems like you love our country, the ideas of liberty, and the Constitution as much as I do. Which is why I am emailing you. Please consider making the most generous donation you can and help me restore our Republic.Please consider this a personal and urgent request from me. Senator Mike Lee | | | If dpwillis67@gmail.com should not be subscribed or if you need to change your subscription information for GOP Presidential, First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

body:

Friend,
**Our country is currently facing a great threat.** A new enemy has emerged from the shadows that seeks to destroy and intimidate their way to a transformed state, and country, that you and I would hardly recognize.
This enemy is the radical vigilante woke mob that will steamroll anything and anyone in their way. Their blatant attacks on the American way of life are clear and intensifying: stifling dissent, public shaming, rampant violence, and a perverted version of history.
A group that will, literally, tear down monuments and buildings but — perhaps in an even more sinister way — tear down the American spirit itself. **They go after the family unit, parental rights, traditional moral values, the church, and fact-based education.**
Over the past few years, we’ve watched horrified as this group has attempted to _**brainwash our children**_ into thinking we live in an evil, racist, irredeemable country.
We listened to them deny science and data to exert political theater all the while _**trampling over personal liberties enshrined in the Constitution.**_
[**> > DONATE NOW TO HELP US CONTINUE THE FIGHT <<**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zne03ftl93beaq022qqpccsgqpm0t66vabp2b0j0_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cdge6o34c9h2bs)
We saw them take to the streets for an entire summer like outlaws burning, looting, and destroying everything in sight while being told they were “mostly peaceful” and “passionate.”
We watched _**Big Tech moguls in Silicon Valley be the arbiters of truth**_ – deciding who gets to speak and who gets silenced through the digital public square.
We listened to the legacy media muffle legitimately verifiable news stories that didn’t align with their preferred narrative, only to watch the truth trickle out months later at a more politically expedient time.
**Well,****Friend****, the time for listening and watching from the sidelines is over.**
This enemy has taken over media, educational institutions, corporate boards, professional sports, foundations, and professional institutions. They have left no corner of our lives untouched. But all hope is not lost.
**We The People still have a say.** We know the truth, you and I, about America and the country she is and can be. We must fight to defeat these false pretenses and predetermined narratives.
**I am choosing to counter this enemy with faith, with reason, and with freedom. As Governor of the Free State of Florida, I have chosen to lead with a vision that builds America up rather than tears it down.**
Together we can ensure that our children are raised to know they live in the greatest state in the nation, the greatest country in the world and that they have an opportunity to continue making them even greater.
[**If you’ve been waiting for the right time to get off the sidelines and fight for the rights you know were given to man by God Himself – the time is NOW.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z1k38t2hu0solomadb47in79435e3ggj556n0to8_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cdge6o34c9h2bs)
[**If you’re with me,**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z5q2dfrl2ajd2g05s4bfl6f7go2laevq5unv0rgo_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cdge6o34c9h2bs)[**Friend****, chip in any amount to help me defeat this enemy.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zje655lbv2l35vc29ikp41oo00sovdj8m7b73a6o_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cdge6o34c9h2bs) I can’t do it without you. I promise you; I will _**never**_ stop fighting.
Sincerely,
Ron DeSantis
[CHIP IN NOW](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z5b7s4isp212cnks1m13tsmmpa4sc0thpdb509mg_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cdge6o34c9h2bs)

Jake Evans Calls for Closed Primary System in Georgia
| | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-rJ7TaLrAcxRL9XVK4p3gqWywDQ7Lp_m-h96s2I2PiKaxsLNhsKU8PKb32vf4tFGniLZbdvgaeO5zpOUHu_d9AxrqkuVdq52Y68ZdLLEGZvwHlCM_pheIcZoCj7O7d_1kwqewcuXFvo=&c=8IhMH5ewd46Q4f6kwPn0b2OLQbY_mYEICB1XmGl6bxN81TqqC5x62Q==&ch=1BL_l6LwKFnLaat6V9a3Qooz7DeWABw-9hunNwKNHglW_YQTk5hOoQ==)
---
| For immediate release June 8th, 2022 Georgia's Open Primary System Subverts Democracy Jake Evans, the Trump-endorsed candidate for Georgia's 6th Congressional District, today called on Georgia to require party registration for primary elections to protect the ability of the party faithful to nominate the candidates of their choice. "Our open primary system allows for partisans to sabotage the primaries of their political opponents," Jake said. "Partisan primaries are intended to allow the two major parties to nominate the candidate that best reflects the views of party members or who has the best chance to win. Our system subverts that principle, and I will fight to see it changed." Georgia's most recent primary on May 24th demonstrated the issue, with 7-10 percent of the electorate of Georgians who had voted in Democratic primaries in the past. "We've seen the closed primary system work extremely well for Florida, with significant growth in Floridians registering as Republicans in recent years," Jake said.

subject: Thank you for your support, Derek

body:
I’m asking you to help make history again.
#
Derek,
In 2018, supporters like you fought our way to winning the most votes of any Democratic campaign in the history of Georgia state elections at the time.
In 2020, you put Georgia’s electoral votes in the blue column for the first time in nearly three decades, and you delivered two historic Senate runoff victories last year, electing Jon Ossoff and Raphael Warnock as our state’s first Jewish and Black senators, respectively.
Now, I’m asking you for the same level of vigor and determination as we work to deliver for Georgians in this time of crisis — and to make history again. We can win the governorship together and create One Georgia, but it will take all of us working our hardest to get it done.
**[Derek, your support is indispensable to our campaign. Will you sign on to become an official member of this campaign right now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46255354/349500839/-1028019001?source=sa_em_welcomeseries2_1&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTQvMS85NDA4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYTU1OGJkMC0yY2U3LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Hob2-odHhR-wxyHzQ-YyMlDActlHEb4273zzg2BhM2g=&emci=93782b96-71ca-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=0a558bd0-2ce7-ec11-b656-281878b85110&ceid=3066577)**
Whether you were part of our efforts since the early days of the 2018 campaign or you just joined us for the first time, I’m so grateful that you are on our team.
Just months from now, we could be preparing to deliver results for the people of Georgia, to expand access to health care and to increase opportunity across our state. But I know how much of your time, talent and treasure winning this fight will require, and that is why I am so honored to have you on our team.

Stacey

Let's dominate Texas in 2024! | | | [](https://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=140553949&msgid=1181115&act=24CB&c=632087&pid=28702925&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.starsandstripesforeverpac.org%2Fpatriotic-clip-recurring.php%3Finfo%3D2022ER0202&cf=48787&v=2a2b9c6d1514b3a8ab92241f8d9d480a8ef25c4a1dd19b678cf726e6775f6409)
---
###### _A Message from.._
##### John Philip Sousa IV
###### National Chairman of Stars & Stripes Forever PAC
###### _Formerly the 2016 Committee and National Draft Ben Carson for President Committee_
| Peter, Our work in Virginia's Governor, Lt. Governor and Attorney General races set the stage for the nationwide mid-terms. Due to the help of our supporters across the nation we were able to run ads in Virginia from October 4 through Election Day 2021 based on our _" Nadler Method"_ of targeting minority voters. The messages in these ads were carefully crafted to address minority voters' concerns and then aired in strategically important cities in Virginia where capturing the minority vote was key to winning. It worked! Republicans swept all three statewide offices and even flipped control of the Virginia House of Delegates by netting 7 seats. And this all happened in a state Joe Biden won by 10 percentage points just 12 months earlier. We followed our _" Nadler Method"_ again just last month and launched ads targeting Latino voters in Texas' 28th congressional district to help Cassy Garcia win the Republican primary run-off. **Thanks to your support, Cassy won.** Starting next month we will be recording new ads for Cassy Garcia (TX-28) and expanding into other congressional districts to help Monica De La Cruz (TX-15) and Myra Flores defeat three Texas Democrats in November. If we win these three seats, Republicans will pick up three seats from the Democrats. | [](https://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=140553949&msgid=1181115&act=24CB&c=632087&pid=28702925&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.starsandstripesforeverpac.org%2Fpatriotic-clip-recurring.php%3Finfo%3D2022ER0202&cf=48787&v=2a2b9c6d1514b3a8ab92241f8d9d480a8ef25c4a1dd19b678cf726e6775f6409)
---
Each of these Conservatives have a good chance of defeating the Democrat candidate in November and flipping it from Democrat to Republican.
In addition, primaries were held in Ohio on May 3 and Trump endorsed candidate, J.D. Vance, who won the Republican primary and will face Democrat Tim Ryan in November. This seat was vacated by Republican Rob Portman and it's imperative that Republicans hold on to this Senate seat. Further, Ohio is a battleground state and we have excellent opportunities to defeat Liberal congressional incumbents and replace them with men and women who share our values.
And lastly, Trump endorsed candidate, Herschel Walker, won the Republican Senate primary in a landslide. True to form, right after the results were announced, Democrats started their attacks on Walker's character. Nonetheless, Senator Raphael Warnock is in for the fight of his life.
[](https://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=140553949&msgid=1181115&act=24CB&c=632087&pid=28702925&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.starsandstripesforeverpac.org%2Fpatriotic-clip-recurring.php%3Finfo%3D2022ER0202&cf=48787&v=2a2b9c6d1514b3a8ab92241f8d9d480a8ef25c4a1dd19b678cf726e6775f6409)
---
President Biden's approval rating has plummeted over the last month to a record low of 40% and his approval rating among Blacks and Latinos continues to decline. If this continues, we will prevail in November. That's why it is imperative that we continue to fight for Conservative victories over Liberals this November to shift the power from the Left over to the Right.
**[We need support from conservative's like you over the next few months as we battle against Socialists and work to make sure that Republicans win the majority in the House and dethrone Nancy Pelosi from her speakership and gain the majority in the Senate.](https://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=140553949&msgid=1181115&act=24CB&c=632087&pid=28702925&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.starsandstripesforeverpac.org%2Fpatriotic-clip-recurring.php%3Finfo%3D2022ER0202&cf=48787&v=2a2b9c6d1514b3a8ab92241f8d9d480a8ef25c4a1dd19b678cf726e6775f6409)**
**There are 17 primaries this month and we 'll want to lend our support to many of the victors in the months ahead. To do that, we'll need to fill our war chest.**
**[Will you help us do that, Peter?](https://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=140553949&msgid=1181115&act=24CB&c=632087&pid=28702925&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.starsandstripesforeverpac.org%2Fpatriotic-clip-recurring.php%3Finfo%3D2022ER0202&cf=48787&v=2a2b9c6d1514b3a8ab92241f8d9d480a8ef25c4a1dd19b678cf726e6775f6409)**
The Democrats are already in motion. They have big money and ground games in place to elect even more socialists to the House and Senate giving Joe Biden more support for his socialist agenda during the second half of his term.
**[I'm asking you to help us make sure we have the funds to continue the battle in Texas, launch in Ohio and Georgia and hand select seats across the nation in battleground races by becoming a Stars and Stripes Defender today.](https://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=140553949&msgid=1181115&act=24CB&c=632087&pid=28702925&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.starsandstripesforeverpac.org%2Fpatriotic-clip-recurring.php%3Finfo%3D2022ER0202&cf=48787&v=2a2b9c6d1514b3a8ab92241f8d9d480a8ef25c4a1dd19b678cf726e6775f6409)**
**[Our _Stars & Stripes Defender_ monthly giving club will allow you to chip in a little each month to make sure we can launch our radio ads state by state as we build our war chest and stay on the air in those crucial contests after the primaries until the November 2024 Elections.](https://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=140553949&msgid=1181115&act=24CB&c=632087&pid=28702925&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.starsandstripesforeverpac.org%2Fpatriotic-clip-recurring.php%3Finfo%3D2022ER0202&cf=48787&v=2a2b9c6d1514b3a8ab92241f8d9d480a8ef25c4a1dd19b678cf726e6775f6409)**
**[Having your monthly commitment of support will greatly help our budgeting as we launch our ads state by state and add more key contests to our Battle Plan. You only have to sign-up once and then your gift will be processed around the same time every month until you tell us to stop.](https://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=140553949&msgid=1181115&act=24CB&c=632087&pid=28702925&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.starsandstripesforeverpac.org%2Fpatriotic-clip-recurring.php%3Finfo%3D2022ER0202&cf=48787&v=2a2b9c6d1514b3a8ab92241f8d9d480a8ef25c4a1dd19b678cf726e6775f6409)**
**[And if you become a _Stars & Stripes Defender_ today, I'll send you this patriotic clip that you can attach to your jacket, luggage, purse or use as a key chain so you can proudly show your love of America. I have mine on my jacket!](https://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=140553949&msgid=1181115&act=24CB&c=632087&pid=28702925&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.starsandstripesforeverpac.org%2Fpatriotic-clip-recurring.php%3Finfo%3D2022ER0202&cf=48787&v=2a2b9c6d1514b3a8ab92241f8d9d480a8ef25c4a1dd19b678cf726e6775f6409)**

Please see a special message from our

Dear
Friend,

While
many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew
the giant, they likely don't know his full story-especially the
tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to
repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about
fathers and sons.

King
David's momentous story provides profound insights into many of
life's most important questions, including: What are my
responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I
lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way
to lead others?

Taught by
Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, "The David
Story: Shepherd, Father, King" examines the Old Testament books
of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores
David's character and the consequences of his choices on his
family and the people of Israel.

This is
why we've produced our online course, "The David Story: Shepherd,
Father, King," which is now available on DVD. And you can reserve
your copy using this secure link:

https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/david-story-dvd

By
viewing the course, you'll learn more about the nature of God,
family, leadership, sin, and repentance; in short, you'll learn
more about what truly matters in life.

I hope
you'll reserve your DVD today and share its abiding lessons with
your family and friends. The DVD is perfect for a Bible study or
homeschool curriculum.

Let's
learn what truly matters in life by studying "The David Story."

Best
regards,

Kyle
Murnen, '09
Director
of Online Learning
Hillsdale
College

P.S. If
you'd like to secure a DVD box set of "The David Story" while
they're available, you can have one shipped directly to your home
for any gift of $100 or more in support of reaching and teaching
millions on behalf of liberty.

Reserve

**Peter,****I’ve been a proud fighter for LGBTQ+ rights for decades now – and as your attorney general, I’ve spent every moment fighting to protect the community from harm.**

In 2019, I led a 22-state coalition that called for federal anti-discrimination laws to protect LGBTQ+ individuals in the workplace. In 2021, I led a coalition of 20 attorneys general against an anti-trans lawsuit in Connecticut and scored a statewide victory for the LGBTQ+ community by ruling that all New Yorkers are entitled to equal access to goods and services. And, most recently, I urged the U.S. Department of Justice to launch a federal investigation into Governor Abbott’s anti-trans law for civil rights violations.

**Peter, the accomplishments above are only a handful of all the victories I’ve won for the LGBTQ+ community in my three and a half years as your attorney general – but this work is far from over. And, with the increase in the GOP’s extremist anti-LGBTQ+ laws that have sprung up across the country, we need to work harder than ever to protect our neighbors and loved ones.**

Peter, I will never flinch in my fight for the voiceless and vulnerable, but I need to know how many fearless fighters I have on my side during this critical moment.
**That’s why, with Pride Month officially underway, I need to collect 5,000 survey responses before midnight. So please, take a moment now to let me know: **

So please, before this survey expires at midnight, will you let me know: | | | | Thank you, Letitia \---------- Forwarded message ---------- From: Letitia James Date: Wed, June 1, 2022 Subject: Re: Pride Month | | | | | = | | Do you think LGBTQ rights should be protected? | | | | Peter,I’ve been a proud fighter for LGBTQ+ rights for decades now – and as your attorney general, I’ve spent every moment fighting to protect the community from harm. In 2019, I led a 22-state coalition that called for federal anti-discrimination laws to protect LGBTQ+ individuals in the workplace. In 2021, I led a coalition of 20 attorneys general against an anti-trans lawsuit in Connecticut and scored a statewide victory for the LGBTQ+ community by ruling that all New Yorkers are entitled to equal access to goods and services. And, most recently, I urged the U.S. Department of Justice to launch a federal investigation into Governor Abbott’s anti-trans law for civil rights violations. Peter, the accomplishments above are only a handful of all the victories I’ve won for the LGBTQ+ community in my three and a half years as your attorney general – but this work is far from over. And, with the increase in the GOP’s extremist anti-LGBTQ+ laws that have sprung up across the country, we need to work harder than ever to protect our neighbors and loved ones. Peter, I will never flinch in my fight for the voiceless and vulnerable, but I need to know how many fearless fighters I have on my side during this critical moment. That’s why, with Pride Month officially underway, I need to collect 5,000 survey responses before midnight. body:
#TeamVasquez won the primary election for New Mexico’s 2nd congressional district | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46263784/349534437/316559552?refcode=fl_email_fr_20220608wewon_gv_all_xx_hdr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzAxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMWYxZjRiMi0zN2U3LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uIw-C8fKcqDnseqoSIkAxK8dzFASIFsFdTFU8dVUShM=)
---
We won, friends! **#TeamVasquez won the primary election for New Mexico’s 2nd congressional district yesterday, making us the official Democratic campaign to take on MAGA extremist Yvette Herrell in November.** I could not be more honored to have your support in this race. [**Our people-powered movement is moving forward to the general! Can you help fuel our campaign to flip NM-02 over these next five months by pitching in any amount today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46263785/349534438/316559552?refcode=fl_email_fr_20220608wewon_gv_all_xx_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzAxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMWYxZjRiMi0zN2U3LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uIw-C8fKcqDnseqoSIkAxK8dzFASIFsFdTFU8dVUShM=) Thank you to those on the campaign team, to our grassroots supporters, and to all the volunteers who have spent countless hours on the phone, in front of their computers, driving through New Mexico's winding roads, working weekends away from families — I see you and I thank you. I am so honored that you believe in me. As a first-generation American, I learned that the American Dream is so much more than a saying. The American Dream is knowing with certainty that the life you are building will lead to an even better life for your children. It’s knowing that your hard work will be rewarded. But right now, with our current representative in this seat playing partisan politics and pushing an extreme, far-right agenda, this dream is not an attainable reality for many New Mexicans. **Yvette Herrell has proven one thing in her time in office, and it’s that she is wrong for New Mexico.** Over the next five months, it will take all of us coming together and working hard to bring progress and a leader who reflects the values of our communities here in NM-02 to Congress. As I drove across our beautiful district over the last year and met so many amazing people, I found myself thinking about a future in which we all thrive. A future where: _Working families and single parents don't have to choose between going to work, school, or paying for childcare._ _People no longer have to choose between paying their utility bills or saving for their children’s education;_ _Undocumented neighbors, coworkers, friends and relatives are not living in fear because they are able to achieve a path to citizenship;_ _Women don't have to fight for their own reproductive and civil rights, and have the power to control their own bodies and decide if or when they want to start a family;_ _Our veterans receive the same high-quality healthcare whether they live in Lordsburg or Albuquerque;_ _We protect the livelihoods and health of fossil fuel workers while shifting aggressively to a renewable energy economy that sustains rural communities;_ _Our LBGTQ relatives don’t face hardship or discrimination, and are treated with respect;_ _When we kiss our children goodbye before they get on the bus, we know they'll be safe;_ _And we have the policies and procedures in place to protect our elderly and immunocompromised from Covid._ **I know this is a future that is within reach, and that change starts at the ballot box. Yesterday, you spoke loud and clear. Today, we get back to work to flip this seat blue in November and set our district on the path to a better, brighter future.** These next five months won't be easy, but with your confidence and faith in me, I commit to you that I will continue to carry the teachings of my Southern New Mexico community, and I will fight for this place that has raised me. clean_body: #TeamVasquez won the primary election for New Mexico’s 2nd congressional district | = We won, friends! #TeamVasquez won the primary election for New Mexico’s 2nd congressional district yesterday, making us the official Democratic campaign to take on MAGA extremist Yvette Herrell in November. I could not be more honored to have your support in this race. = Thank you to those on the campaign team, to our grassroots supporters, and to all the volunteers who have spent countless hours on the phone, in front of their computers, driving through New Mexico's winding roads, working weekends away from families — I see you and I thank you. I am so honored that you believe in me. As a first-generation American, I learned that the American Dream is so much more than a saying. The American Dream is knowing with certainty that the life you are building will lead to an even better life for your children. It’s knowing that your hard work will be rewarded. But right now, with our current representative in this seat playing partisan politics and pushing an extreme, far-right agenda, this dream is not an attainable reality for many New Mexicans. Yvette Herrell has proven one thing in her time in office, and it’s that she is wrong for New Mexico. Over the next five months, it will take all of us coming together and working hard to bring progress and a leader who reflects the values of our communities here in NM-02 to Congress. As I drove across our beautiful district over the last year and met so many amazing people, I found myself thinking about a future in which we all thrive. A future where: Working families and single parents don't have to choose between going to work, school, or paying for childcare. People no longer have to choose between paying their utility bills or saving for their children’s education; Undocumented neighbors, coworkers, friends and relatives are not living in fear because they are able to achieve a path to citizenship; Women don't have to fight for their own reproductive and civil rights, and have the power to control their own bodies and decide if or when they want to start a family; Our veterans receive the same high-quality healthcare whether they live in Lordsburg or Albuquerque; We protect the livelihoods and health of fossil fuel workers while shifting aggressively to a renewable energy economy that sustains rural communities; Our LBGTQ relatives don’t face hardship or discrimination, and are treated with respect; When we kiss our children goodbye before they get on the bus, we know they'll be safe; And we have the policies and procedures in place to protect our elderly and immunocompromised from Covid. I know this is a future that is within reach, and that change starts at the ballot box. Yesterday, you spoke loud and clear. Today, we get back to work to flip this seat blue in November and set our district on the path to a better, brighter future. These next five months won't be easy, but with your confidence and faith in me, I commit to you that I will continue to carry the teachings of my Southern New Mexico community, and I will fight for this place that has raised me. I will make you proud. Thank you. Si se puede! Roberts, President of The Heritage Foundation. And I’m writing today because I would like to help. That girl is me, friend.
I grew up the daughter of a maid and a janitor, living with my six siblings in a two-bedroom, A-framed home in Jacksonville. With a lot of hard work, I became the first in my family to graduate college – and then, I entered the police academy at a time when there were hardly any Black women working as officers.
People told me I didn't belong in the force, but I risked my life to protect my community, working the night shifts as a beat cop. Years later, I became the first woman to serve as Orlando's chief of police.
I'm no stranger to adversity, friend. That's why it doesn't faze me when people like the chair of the Republican National Committee attack me personally, or when the GOP launches desperate attack ads to defeat me. **I always keep my eye on the prize, but the truth is I know I can't win this race alone. body:

---
| |
---
| | Dear Peter,

June is typically a slow month for activity, volunteers and donations. Minnesotans often take off for vacations and "check out" for a little while. Well, not this year! Our campaign continues to work hard, travel the state, and get Minnesotans engaged. I think people recognize how big the stakes are this year. We're showing we have [solutions to ease the burden at the gas pump](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=468c48911a&e=33b11688c1); we're [meeting people in Minneapolis](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=718b59288a&e=33b11688c1) and across Minnesota who may not traditionally vote Republican; we're [maintaining a rigorous campaign](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=e5df87f803&e=33b11688c1) schedule which will only grow.
**_Now we need you._ We need to ensure June is not a "slow" month for small-dollar fundraising as it has been traditionally for Republican governor candidates.**

**We have so many ways you can give and help contribute to this people-driven campaign:**
* [Donate through our website](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=2b27838ce1&e=33b11688c1) (_any amount helps_ and you can get $50 refunded through Minnesota's PCR program)
* [Get Scott Jensen/Matt Birk merchandise](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=35bbf310e9&e=33b11688c1) (all proceeds go to our campaign and help fuel this movement)
* [Get rally signs, fence banners, or even a banner for your barn](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=458fa954af&e=33b11688c1) (we'll have yard signs available later in June and will update you on that as soon as we can)!
* [Get my newest book "We've Been Played: Exposing the Triad of Tyranny"](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=b225649903&e=33b11688c1) (for every $25 donated here, we'll send you a copy)

**We need you now more than ever.** Help us defeat the normal "Summer Slump" many Republicans experience and send a message to Tim Walz and Peggy Flanagan: "conservatives and every-day Minnesotans aren't taking any time off this year in order to win. We know the stakes and we're playing for keeps in 2022!" [Join this movement!](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=be5c4e3b62&e=33b11688c1)
---
| Thank you, and LET'S WIN in November!

In Freedom,

Dr. Scott Jensen
Republican Candidate for Governor - Minnesota

**1\. Build On State-of-the-Art Mapping Capabilities**

In several states – including North Carolina, Ohio, Texas, and others where litigation is pending – it’s possible that new maps will need to be drawn before the 2024 elections. To prepare, we’re investing in new technologies, data, and mapping innovations.

[Donate to support fair maps!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46273910/349555251/-507439490?amount=20&refcode=20220608.1r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQwYzlhOWJkLTQwZTctZWMxMS1iNjU2LTI4MTg3OGI4NTExMCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=rqjdaMNQG81AWdIo0Zn5WN_krZGlyzEdAWH8p1F22fE=)
**2\. Continue Supporting Voters in Litigation**

Our affiliates are still supporting voters in lawsuits to secure fair maps ahead of the 2022 midterms. And in other states, voters are pursuing litigation to achieve fair maps before the 2024 elections. Here at NDRC, we need to continue to be agile about adjusting our strategy to account for these legal challenges.

We’re also preparing for additional legal threats from Republicans, including the dangerous independent state legislature theory that suggests state lawmakers should have unprecedented and unchecked power over maps and elections.
[Donate to support our strategic
responses to ongoing litigation](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46273911/349555252/-507439490?amount=20&refcode=20220608.1r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQwYzlhOWJkLTQwZTctZWMxMS1iNjU2LTI4MTg3OGI4NTExMCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=rqjdaMNQG81AWdIo0Zn5WN_krZGlyzEdAWH8p1F22fE=)
**3\. Improve Redistricting Reforms**

In 2018 and 2020, we worked to help pass redistricting reforms that were instrumental in securing fair maps in states like Colorado and Michigan. Moving forward, we plan to build on the lessons we learned from these victories to achieve reforms in even more states.
[Donate to support redistricting reforms](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46273912/349555253/-507439490?amount=20&refcode=20220608.1r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQwYzlhOWJkLTQwZTctZWMxMS1iNjU2LTI4MTg3OGI4NTExMCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=rqjdaMNQG81AWdIo0Zn5WN_krZGlyzEdAWH8p1F22fE=)
**4\. Target Elections Important to Redistricting**

Our work in 2018 and 2020 to help elect Democrats running for state-level offices made a big difference. In states like Pennsylvania, Kansas, and Wisconsin, Democratic governors vetoed gerrymandered maps.

And now, Republicans are ramping up their efforts to target state court elections in an effort to install judges they believe will rubber stamp their gerrymandering schemes. That means we need to prepare for the long term by electing pro-democracy leaders.
[Donate to elect pro-democracy candidates](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46273913/349555254/-507439490?amount=20&refcode=20220608.1r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQwYzlhOWJkLTQwZTctZWMxMS1iNjU2LTI4MTg3OGI4NTExMCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=rqjdaMNQG81AWdIo0Zn5WN_krZGlyzEdAWH8p1F22fE=)

Continue Supporting Voters in Litigation Our affiliates are still supporting voters in lawsuits to secure fair maps ahead of the 2022 midterms. And in other states, voters are pursuing litigation to achieve fair maps before the 2024 elections. Here at NDRC, we need to continue to be agile about adjusting our strategy to account for these legal challenges. We’re also preparing for additional legal threats from Republicans, including the dangerous independent state legislature theory that suggests state lawmakers should have unprecedented and unchecked power over maps and elections. = 3\. Improve Redistricting Reforms In 2018 and 2020, we worked to help pass redistricting reforms that were instrumental in securing fair maps in states like Colorado and Michigan. Moving forward, we plan to build on the lessons we learned from these victories to achieve reforms in even more states. = 4\. Target Elections Important to Redistricting Our work in 2018 and 2020 to help elect Democrats running for state-level offices made a big difference. In states like Pennsylvania, Kansas, and Wisconsin, Democratic governors vetoed gerrymandered maps. And now, Republicans are ramping up their efforts to target state court elections in an effort to install judges they believe will rubber stamp their gerrymandering schemes. 🌈 Be proud today and every day, friends! **It’s officially Pride Month — a time of celebration, festivity, and reflection for the LGBTQ+ community. 🏳️🌈🏳️⚧️** This month, I’m reflecting on the advocates of the LGBTQ+ movement who are paving the way for Americans to live freely and authentically. Trailblazers from Pennsylvania like U.S. assistant health secretary Dr. Rachael Levine, the highest-ranking openly trans official in the federal government, and Rep. Malcolm Kenyatta, the first openly gay Black representative in the PA House, broke barriers in LGBTQ+ representation in government. As we celebrate how far we've come, let's also remember that we have a long way to go. In Pennsylvania, it is still legal to discriminate based on sexual orientation, gender identity, and gender expression. In 2022, that’s unacceptable. **LGBTQ+ Pennsylvanians deserve equal rights and equal opportunities.** That’s why we must pass _The Equality Act_ — legislation that secures federal nondiscrimination protections in housing, employment, education, and much more. Across the country, Republican-led state legislatures are ramping up their attacks by passing laws targeting queer children and trans youth. I am committed to standing alongside the LGBTQ+ community in their fight for justice and freedom. Peter, Seth knows that the path to a strong middle class starts with empowering workers and building unions. That's why he's proud to stand with Starbucks workers in Warwick as they organize to fight for better wages and working conditions, and become the first unionized Starbucks in Rhode Island. Peter – for too long, the American Dream has been out of reach for too many people as the cost of living rises and people need to work harder and harder just to put food on the table. A strong labor movement is essential to rebuilding the middle class and ensuring hard working Americans can keep up with the rising cost of living. That's why Seth stands in solidarity with Starbucks employees in Warwick looking to form a union and he's ready to go to Congress to fight for every workers' right to organize to secure better wages and working conditions. As a member of Congress, Seth will continue to fight for working people by investing in infrastructure to create good paying jobs, prioritizing safety standards in the workplace, and protecting the right to organize. He supports the Protecting the Right to Organize Act (PRO Act) to expand labor protections and ensure workers have the freedom to decide whether they wish to form a union without the fear of retaliation. That's why working people across Rhode Island are supporting Seth's campaign. Thanks, Team Seth Seth Magaziner has a proven record of fighting for working people in Rhode Island. | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE WEDNESDAY, JUNE 8
LOEFFLER OP-ED: GEORGIA'S ROADMAP TO A CONSERVATIVE COMEBACK
ATLANTA - In case you missed it, Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler authored an [op-ed](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010DseXXMjtNoCKKU_wRj2kX4G61-_JRDR808gOrsXZGo7TOXgM_PFV7lD6f2vGNqiSzp1ok-59AnnlcljDUdj_2UcBhnZcQnW7wZi9kOAEmXLZtzOryN1IrrbdmEc_TKLkQI7g8H5cQ3stKL3Dxj-LSwhLruZggweXD_CRG3hlv4BBhJn_h0N2hDxB7uXO6NBbQEgF5u3T8gXU-ghLdWd3H6rRTJMvwmW-DxSrYyRs8xSUG60Nyz-a2Lu9UMydMWow5K7RCNKeRsvF_ACZyNY5Q==&c=QOdl9YJVjU0lrUUwDD9RGB3P-uO9a9SaK11-g6kv068wZXCZuRUPQw==&ch=j1UANzSZ-1EWAnePuS7s1L2wiCtqjW7SX3aK7u2IlKKdApgLBnoetg==) for the Washington Examiner yesterday, analyzing Georgia's historic midterm elections - and laying out a roadmap for a conservative comeback in states across the nation. If other states follow Georgia's lead with comprehensive election integrity laws, strong candidates at the top of the ballot, and a consistent focus on registration and mobilization, then local conservative movements can grow by engaging and energizing voters - and deliver results up and down the ballot in November. Click [HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010DseXXMjtNoCKKU_wRj2kX4G61-_JRDR808gOrsXZGo7TOXgM_PFV7lD6f2vGNqiSzp1ok-59AnnlcljDUdj_2UcBhnZcQnW7wZi9kOAEmXLZtzOryN1IrrbdmEc_TKLkQI7g8H5cQ3stKL3Dxj-LSwhLruZggweXD_CRG3hlv4BBhJn_h0N2hDxB7uXO6NBbQEgF5u3T8gXU-ghLdWd3H6rRTJMvwmW-DxSrYyRs8xSUG60Nyz-a2Lu9UMydMWow5K7RCNKeRsvF_ACZyNY5Q==&c=QOdl9YJVjU0lrUUwDD9RGB3P-uO9a9SaK11-g6kv068wZXCZuRUPQw==&ch=j1UANzSZ-1EWAnePuS7s1L2wiCtqjW7SX3aK7u2IlKKdApgLBnoetg==) to view the op-ed, or read the full text below:
A Peach State road map to conservative victory
Dale Carnegie famously said, "The past is where you learned the lesson. The future is where you apply the lesson. Don't give up in the middle."
After 2020, Georgia Republicans learned a number of lessons, chief among them: In a red state, the Left's voter mobilization machine can tip the scales. That year, it raised over $100 million in largely out-of-state funding, thousands of paid staff, and coordination across organizations and campaigns. The fallout of picking off two U.S. Senate seats -- and handing President Joe Biden control of the House and the Senate -- is still felt by the nation.
A lot could have happened in Georgia after the contentious 2020 elections, but conservatives here didn't "give up in the middle." Instead, we passed a comprehensive election integrity law, rallied the base with strong conservative candidates and campaigns, and got back to basics by building the infrastructure to grow, reengage, and reenergize the movement.
The lessons of the last cycle were not lost -- and it's the entire reason why, immediately after leaving the U.S. Senate in January 2021, I started "Greater Georgia." It's a data-driven voter mobilization organization with the goal of registering, educating, and engaging conservatives with a year-round outreach apparatus. Over the last 16 months, we've made nearly 2 million voter contacts -- registering conservatives, working with disengaged and disenfranchised Georgians, reaching diverse communities to build new constituencies, and educating voters on the state's commonsense election laws. Basically, we're empowering the voter. The results have been tremendous. In Georgia's May 24 primary election, 1.93 million Georgians voted -- up a whopping and historic 66% from the 2018 midterm primary. Of that, over 1.2 million Republicans cast ballots, up 98% from four years ago. Democrats also shattered their midterm turnout record, up 30% over 2018.
The data get even more compelling. According to Greater Georgia's analysis of absentee ballot and early voting, or ABEV, data, which are the only data currently available, over 85,000 conservatives who voted in the Republican primary had not voted in any of the last four primary elections. Similarly, over 21,000 Republican voters who failed to vote in the January 2021 runoff election returned this year. The disengaged and disenfranchised are coming back when we do the work to reach them.
Perhaps most under-reported in the media is the dramatic increase in minority voters casting Republican ballots. Compared to Republican ABEV results from 2018, Asian American turnout rose 375%, black turnout increased by 281%, and Hispanic turnout increased by 397%. We're shifting from transactions to relationships. The historic turnout both confirms proof of concept for Georgia conservatives and shatters the Left's narratives. For months, hysterical talking points at the highest levels in America decried the Georgia Election Integrity Act as a "racist" Jim Crow 2.0 law.
Actually, Georgia's SB-202 expanded early voting, codified ballot drop boxes, required voter ID, banned outside money such as Zuckerbucks, and increased fraud protection. It was the centerpiece of the effort to restore voter confidence and bring voters back to the polls after unprecedented changes to elections in 2020. It was a key reason for the record turnout.
Yes, there were contentious primaries with political heavyweights from the top to the bottom of the ballot, but they were rooted in kitchen-table issues and anchored by enthusiasm-building campaigns that turned out the base, the middle, and new voters alike. Amid the fallout of the Left's policies, such as runaway inflation, open borders, spiking crime, pandemic scare tactics, and the liberal indoctrination in schools, Georgians understood the stakes and took action. The contrast of conservative leadership, which produced a nearly decade long distinction as the No. 1 state for business and the freedoms during the pandemic, provided a powerful backdrop.
There's still a long way to go until November 2022.
So now is the time to double down. But it is worth acknowledging what has worked. It is clear to me that year-round conservative mobilization is a game-changer. Infrastructure and growth are required, not optional. Campaigns and candidates must continue to work around the clock -- there's no substitute for a voter understanding the stakes of elections. Strong, commonsense election integrity laws also play a critical role because they support, not suppress, turnout.
In the Peach State, that blueprint resulted in a historic turnout in the primary, and for other states, it offers the same opportunity. In spite of the noise from the far Left and the storied strength of the far Left's machine, it's time to apply the lessons of 2020.
With them, as Georgia has proven, all signs point to a conservative comeback in November.
Businesswoman and former U.S. Sen. Kelly Loeffler is the founder and chairwoman of Greater Georgia Action.

PRESS RELEASE
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
CONTACT:
press@nickfornj.com

** Statement from Nick De Gregorio
------------------------------------------------------------
“Last November, with my young family in tow, I stepped down from a well-paying job and announced my candidacy for United States Congress. It was a risk I felt I needed to take for my country.

For seven months, we tirelessly made our case to the voters. Early this morning, it became clear that they opted to go a different direction. It is a decision I respect. Congratulations to Frank Pallotta. I urge my supporters to get behind Frank and the Republican ticket this Fall.

There can be no victory without unity. With the primary done and dusted, the real fight for the soul of America now begins. Our true opponent is not our fellow Republican. It is not our fellow American citizen. It is inflation, it is taxation, it is the marginalization of our parents, police, and veterans. We are witnessing American decline, and we must act now—united—to stop it.

In victory we realize our potential, but in defeat we realize who we are. I am proud of the campaign I ran, and of the people who helped me run it. Seven days a week, we gave it everything we had. I now look forward to spending those days with my wife and kids again.” - Nick De Gregorio

Hello,
Well, that didn’t take long. **Less than an hour after I was declared the Democratic nominee for Senate in Iowa last night, the attacks from Chuck Grassley began.**
_“The most liberal nominee in Iowa Senate history”
“Radical”
“Socialist”_
Gotta love it!
Chuck Grassley doesn’t know what to say about me. He’s never faced an opponent like me before. I’m his political nightmare, so he’s just throwing cow pies at the wall and hoping something sticks.
Calling me “radical” is laughable when Chuck Grassley supports a complete ban on abortion and letting literally anyone buy an AR-15 without even a background check. **But there’s one attack that I absolutely won’t take lying down, and that’s Chuck Grassley’s attacking me for serving our country for 36 years in the U.S. Navy.**
Grassley is already trying to say that because I enlisted in the military at age 19, because my deployments meant that my family had to move from state-to-state and country-to-country... that I’m not an Iowan anymore.
Chuck Grassley wants to pretend that I wasn’t raised in rural, northwest Iowa. He ignores the enormous sacrifices that my family – my wife and my kids – made to allow me to serve in the Navy.
**Grassley’s attacks denigrate every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, spend holidays away from each other, and be absent from life’s big events like weddings and the birth of a child.**
**And if Chuck Grassley thinks that I will stand silent while he says that every Iowan who puts on our country’s uniform stops being an Iowan... he’s delusional.**
These are the kinds of attacks I’m going to be up against. Nasty stuff from Chuck Grassley, Mitch McConnell, and the Fox ‘Entertainment’ News propaganda network.
There’s one reason why: The GOP is scared. They’ve seen the polls, and they know that if we defeat Grassley and turn Iowa blue this November, Democrats are guaranteed to maintain our Senate majority.
**In order to fight back, we need to raise another $100,000 before midnight tomorrow, but the only way we’ll hit our goal and send Grassley packing is if grassroots donors like you give right now:**

LA's runoff starts NOW.

Hello,

First of all, I want to say THANK YOU. I know it's not easy to tune in and play a part in running a successful campaign during such a crucial election year. This team has made sacrifices of time, talent, and resources to build a truly grassroots movement.

And because of that work, we're headed to a runoff against Rick Caruso in November. I am ready to roll up my sleeves and tackle the problems our city faces – not looking for credit but looking for solutions.

We have big, urgent problems that need fixing and I know that **together** , we can get it done.

Now, we take some time to celebrate this victory, but I would be remiss if I didn't talk a little bit about what's next. We've already built a huge grassroots team with offices around the city. That's going to keep happening. We're going to get to work to talk to every Angeleno.

But while that's happening, my opponent is going to be trying to own the airwaves like he did in the primary. We've seen him smash spending records already and it's clear he's trying to buy his way to the top.

**This choice could not be any more stark for Los Angeles.**

I'm so thankful for what you've done for me. And I'm thankful for the work that will come next. Let's get out there and WIN.
