subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zarj3dgrm0prh7gpvu5if6ol2506h9fc2j04k238_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2ugr62p37ceo75dlh6gpj4oj3mjhr5c3m69pr5c73e2p7dcrhc5pb4ttgs4qe2c37q9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhm0shkcoonecr46urm2phlc2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8gq48bi4bh28or5c5jm0pb0shgm49fg)
This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zobt19ruhalbldsqkmbjga6077621oq9d5p5clt8_rp22sh2s8i66pb1ctg6ao74c5h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z11mivoftc0u2067g8sunguok3atds3i89a2nen0_rp22sh2s8i66pb1ctg6ao74c5h2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zj45col1dsbcfa88amt1948ba9u9n7qguj6bjrf0_rp22sh2s8i66pb1ctg6ao74c5h2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Big news, folks — we had _huge_ wins in the New Mexico democratic primary elections last night: 17 of the incredible candidates we endorsed and supported WON their primaries. Join me in celebrating them! You are a big part of these victories — and I can’t thank you enough. Every single one of these folks is a champion for New Mexican families. They will fight for the solutions our communities are counting on — from improving public safety and protecting our public lands and the right to choose, to creating good-paying jobs, increasing affordable housing, and acting on climate change. I also want to thank Zack Quintero and Darrell Deaguero for running solid races. I was proud to support them and know they will find new ways to contribute and lead. And a big congratulations to Joseph Maestas and Cynthia Borrego for winning their primary elections against Zack and Darrell. Joseph and Cynthia ran strong races and, I’m confident, are committed to serving New Mexico well. It couldn’t be more important to elect Democrats at every level of government with so much at stake. But winning doesn’t come easy. I endorsed these folks early on because getting strong candidates the resources and support they need can make the difference between winning and losing. **It will take even more resources to get these candidates across the finish line in November. | | This past week _Politico_ published an article detailing a strategy to target and potentially overturn votes in swing states like Michigan, by installing bad faith individuals prepared to oversee and even interfere with voting and the election process. This is all part of a broader national strategy to sow chaos in the vote count and certification process and undermine the will of the people. Here’s the good news: Fair Fight Action has been preparing for this moment, and we want to share with you some of the ways we’re fighting back. Over the last several months, Fair Fight Action and our pro-democracy allies have crafted strategic plans to ensure that the will of the people is upheld. This coalition is supporting clerks so they can do their jobs, pushing back against attempts to insert bad actors into the process, and providing state-specific strategies to combat on the ground anti-voting efforts. [_**We will not stand for these types of targeted and partisan attacks intended to intimidate and suppress the voices of eligible voters. The best way to counter these attacks is by supporting organizations like Fair Fight Action. Bill has been a champion in the House on many important issues – from the housing crisis to combating the COVID-19 pandemic to defending reproductive rights and so much more. Republicans only need to flip a handful of seats to take back the majority. It’s why they’re coming so viciously after Bill’s seat. = Thank you, Team Durbin **= Paid for by Friends of Dick Durbin

**Please join us on Monday, June 13th at 7pm**! This is the first ever in-person screening of the documentary, "A Tiny Ripple of Hope." You can get your questions answered from Jahmal and the film's director, Jason Polevoi during the Q&A afterwards.

The film follows my experiences building a nonprofit, and struggling with all the sacrifices I had to make to fight for the people of this city. **I always say, I'm a volunteer at heart.** Watch [this video](https://cole2022.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7401cdbeeb0470d9b36be09ed&id=c44bd5ee5f&e=339f142c50) from WTTW on how my my nonprofit has always responded to our community's needs, including during the pandemic.

Jahmal Cole

body:
Team —

We all watched Jared Moskowitz’s work as a State Representative in the wake of the Marjory Stoneman Douglas shooting.

He saved lives and prevented gun violence when he passed the largest gun violence prevention, school safety, and mental health legislation in Florida history after the tragedy.

His actions in that moment proved that he was the right person to lead us through disasters as Director of Florida’s Division of Emergency Management.

I’m so thankful that he was in that position during the pandemic, because his laser-focused leadership ensured the distribution of testing, vaccines, and personal protective equipment efficiently and effectively.

I know that Jared will be the same fierce advocate and Democratic leader when he serves as a Member of Congress. That’s why I’m proud to endorse his campaign.

I hope you’ll join me and support Jared in this critical election. Please remember to vote on or before August 23rd, and help us spread the word!

With Gratitude,

Daniella Levine Cava

clean_body: | | | | Summer is right around the corner, and the campaign is in full gear. Dear Friend, Summer is right around the corner, and the campaign is in full gear. We just completed a very successful month on the campaign trail, and we are feeling very, very good about where we are at this point in the race. Our message is being spread far and wide – our ads are on TV and we’re on the " radio". Everywhere I go, people are telling me that they are seeing our TV ads, this is encouraging, and could not be possible without the support of individuals like you, who believe in our campaign. WATCH OUR “PARENTAL RIGHTS” AD HERE: With only two months to go until the primary election, there’s clearly a lot of and excitement surrounding our campaign. I’m out and about every day meeting voters, and everywhere I go, I can feel the enthusiasm. It is truly humbling to have the support of so many Marylanders who are optimistic about the future of our state and who want to continue to keep moving our state in the right direction. We’ve been talking about the issues that matter most to Marylanders: expanding opportunities, keeping communities safe, ensuring that all children receive a world-class education, and growing our economy while focusing on making our state more affordable for you and your family. Here are a few interviews I’ve done recently on some important topics: INFLATION TAX: EDUCATION: CRIME: We’ve had some really important announcements recently, that I’d like for you to know about. In addition to surpassing well over 1,000 volunteers, we have now secured the endorsements of over 90 elected officials across the state, showcasing our strength among our party. These elected leaders know that I am the only Republican candidate who can win in November and the only candidate who can prevent our state from going back to the failed days of Martin O’Malley. Our grassroots army of supporters continues to grow as well. Last month, I was excited to launch our " Women for Kelly") coalition – more than 200 mothers, grandmothers, elected officials, and community leaders have already signed up to be a part of our efforts. Like me, these women want to make sure that their families are safe, that they are empowered in their children’s education, and that opportunities present themselves for all Marylanders – that is exactly what we are focused on. Law enforcement officers know that I am the only candidate in this race who will tackle violent crime and stand up for the brave men and women who serve and protect our communities. That is why I am so proud to have launched the " Law Enforcement for Kelly") coalition and have received the backing of seven sheriffs across the state. No other candidate in this race has such strong and explicit backing from law enforcement leaders – I am honored that they entrust me to make Maryland safe. LAW ENFORCEMENT FOR KELLY: If you are interested in joining either one of these coalitions you can do so here: " ") I’ve got a few important reminders for you! The primary election is on July 19th, however, for those of you who requested ballots, they’re set to hit your mailboxes soon, if they haven’t already. Please make sure to send these back and have them postmarked by July 19th. Additionally, early voting starts on July 7th and will run until July 14th. If you’d like some more information on early voting sites or would like to request an absentee ballot you can visit the following website: " ") Thank you again for your support, it means the world to me. Our campaign is in a great position, and I look forward to celebrating a great victory with you on July 19th. subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsu_dfkhSN

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only
take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our
nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives-but
supported by many well-meaning Americans-to change the way we
elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the
Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osu_dfkhSN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent
matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but
the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by
progressives-but supported by many well-meaning Americans-to
change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do
away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our
Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a
National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to
me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more
clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning
this issue-views we will make available to policymakers and
opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on
Presidential Selection by using the link below:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey

For most of our nation's history, the
Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution,
was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to
preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have
joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional
bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution
has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to
provide young people with a proper grounding in American
civics-too many Americans simply don't understand the importance
of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has
expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide,
directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the
Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide
through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The
Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over 5.6 million households and
businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of
liberty;

Promoting constitutional education
through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of
America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across
America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education
through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which
launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools
nationwide.

Your answers to the National Survey on
Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most
effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the
importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this
critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent
topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection
and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a
few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure
link I've provided below:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey

And after you take your survey, I hope you
will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a
tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing
truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its
extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is
essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the
National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for
your time and attention-and for your friendship and support of
liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

body:

Peter, happy Pride Month! This month, I'm celebrating the LGBTQ community and acknowledging the brave advocates who fought for years to be able to be their true, authentic selves every day and in every space.
**But Pride Month is also a time for bold action.** That means electing leaders to the Senate who will defend gender-affirming healthcare, protect the right to marry whomever you love, and allow our kids to live safely and authentically at school.
As a nurse, I know how important it is to ensure LGBTQ Americans can access the affordable, equitable, and high-quality healthcare they deserve.
As a mom, I know that this community deserves to have someone with a big, compassionate heart in the Senate fighting for their rights and their future.
As a Missourian, I know that this state and this country should be a place where it's safe for everyone to live and love however they choose.
But right now, too many leaders in Washington are promoting hateful agendas that threaten to push us backward and pose real bodily harm to LGBTQ Americans. Extremists are putting our neighbors and community members at risk simply to win political points. They're even targeting our children with their bigoted ideology.
These attacks are scary and infuriating. **That’s why we need more leaders in Congress who will protect the rights of LGBTQ Americans. Because at the end of the day, I want to see kindness, acceptance, and community win over hate.** But that won’t happen overnight. It takes dedication and real, meaningful work.
**So I'm making a promise to you: When I get to Washington, I will put in the work it takes to defend LGBTQ rights, move our country forward, and ensure that compassion wins.[If you're with me on this, can you pitch in a donation today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46280598/349586344/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk48-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNzE3NDA5My01NWU3LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UDP-lNBZGewwPtujJF3BkAURgL6-rrhU4bC2qEjn7rY=)**

body:
Later tonight, the January 6 committee will begin its public hearings, sharing with the country all they’ve learned during their investigation.
#
Derek —
Later tonight, the January 6 committee will begin its public hearings, sharing with the country all they’ve learned during their investigation.
And one of the sad, sad, truths we will probably hear about is the shocking number of veterans who participated in the Capitol insurrection.

| | I’ve never been deterred by prospects. I’ve never avoided doing what’s right because of the fear of consequences. It’s a fundamental conviction that leaves me in peace. The hardest part of last night isn’t the results of the election; it’s confronting the fact that, if I wanted to, I have the privilege to move on and enjoy my life while millions of others don’t even have the bare minimum. It’s a thought that keeps me awake at night. It’s also a thought that commits me to rectifying this inhumane adversity. Despite the challenges of running for a federal office with only $9,000, a last name that invokes disgust among Democrats, teaching full-time, and an unimaginable level of resistance, I’m so proud of our accomplishments. We forced Donald Norcross to co-sponsor Medicare for All - the issue that prompted my primary challenge. We exposed the ways in which the Norcross insurance brokerage depletes school and municipal resources. We also overcame ballot hurdles meant to dilute the influence of dissident candidates. The most rewarding part of this experience has been connecting with those who feel just as passionately as I do. I’m in awe of your selflessness. I’m your number one fan. Thank you so sincerely.

As a diplomat in the Obama administration, Tom Malinowski stood up to dictators overseas. Now experts say his re-election could be THE deciding race for control of the House this year. If you’d like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.malinowskifornj.com/p/Bix_Do8Sr0m0vj5sQl0SCA2?unsubscribedata=iHvDI3LuS5VHEuIRugwF6mo0I4QFXLq2RsyYQzu5aOxhSkX5cVJMtLEIQFEecca9KH8yGGeqC4vtrsf5CcrFJmup0v%2F2Gfhmt%2B3d%2BlzXV1VLdG23ivh9Eh65PRED8Gog8dMuEstDlFnryzNP2sbQKiYNemx00qq0VmUaMub43OeZGch9PxhrDSDsdHGESQiusY%2BrXC7gezJqmr4pR3mF3BmwxbWvqr%2BRnFyG504eQbY%2B1QEKDaoaeBb%2FsvmXZm4mdeCUbffi%2BTZv3Ogydf9knnr646wQIgnQ53Lb3QK3XcFt%2Bqj352qt6VKzHojYxsup7VnZRUTSVWZDpM%2B30%2Fb%2BF%2FsIIDsO%2F5%2Bb3H3Lg6yP8whJcg%2BoJg0QO%2FhsDmneTgOm712GH8WDWyk10TJ9QQn8O3%2B8cdMJUTT%2BjQKqyg6Zbb%2F%2BdWOaf00P0%2Ft5wNEn7WYY)

| |
---
Hi,

**I am beyond honored to have earned the Democratic nomination for Congress in our district again. I can’t thank you enough for your help in making this happen.** Since our first victory in 2018, this team has always shown up for New Jersey and our country’s future.

**I am also proud to have accepted the nomination of a new party in New Jersey – the Moderate Party,** which was formed by Republicans and Independents, including elected Republican officials in our district who are splitting with the NJ GOP and walking away from Tom Kean Jr. They are fed up by the extremism and chaos on their side, what has happened to their party since Donald Trump took it over and who are desperately trying to find a way to bring this country back to the center, back to moderation.

**And I think that's reflective of where we are right now.** There is a growing alliance in this country and this district, of Democrats, Independents, and moderate Republicans who are just tired of being told to hate their neighbors over politics. They want to get a sense of community back. They want to be able to go to baseball games, and bake sales, and parades, and have legitimate constructive arguments about policy, but not ones that break up families and ruin friendships and lead to violence in this country. There's a yearning out there for leaders who when they see a fire burning, reach for a bucket of water, not a canister of gasoline. That's the kind of leadership that I've tried to offer these last four years. It's why we are attracting Independents and Republicans to unite with us around those values. It's why we're unified around this campaign.

In the coming months, there’s a whole lot of work ahead. The election-denying, vaccine-disparaging, radical right wing of the GOP is not backing down in their all-out attempt to flip this seat and end our Democratic majority in the House. But I'm absolutely confident that together, this team is going to win another historic election in this district that is going to send a message around the country about where we should be going as Americans over the next two years.

I can’t tell you how inspired I am by folks like you who continue to speak up and put in the work to make our state, and our country, a better place for all of us. subject: Enough is enough. Join March for Our Lives on June 11
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Keystone Progress Education Fund, www
body:
Dear Friend,

March for Our Lives [https://marchforourlives.com/] seeks to change policies to combat the overwhelming gun violence plaguing the U.S. We support their efforts to make real, lasting change. On June 11, we're asking you to join a March for Our Lives rally, either here in Pennsylvania or in D.C. There will be 300+ local marches across the nation.

Find a march on Saturday near you. [https://secure.everyaction.com/p/4X6lOpXbV0e3Ba9SGz3dvw2]

This is a public health crisis. Just this weekend, unknown multiple shooters fired rounds of bullets into crowds in downtown Philadelphia, killing at least six and injuring many others. They were out in South Street, just having dinner, enjoying their Saturday night. Their lives were senselessly cut short — and by multiple shooters! We are held hostage by the inability of our leaders to act on gun violence.

We need change now.

March for Our Lives is working to make it happen. They are policy-based and community-rooted and call for safety — grounded in the perspectives of gun violence survivors and their families, and bolstered by policy analysis and conversation. They are working to fight underlying forces that fuel gun violence. And we’re standing with them this week — and always.

Join the movement this Saturday! [https://secure.everyaction.com/p/4X6lOpXbV0e3Ba9SGz3dvw2]

Laura Nevitt
Operations Manager
Keystone Progress

clean_body: Dear Friend, March for Our Lives [] seeks to change policies to combat the overwhelming gun violence plaguing the U.S. We support their efforts to make real, lasting change. On June 11, we're asking you to join a March for Our Lives rally, either here in Pennsylvania or in D.C. There will be 300+ local marches across the nation. Find a march on Saturday near you. [] This is a public health crisis. Just this weekend, unknown multiple shooters fired rounds of bullets into crowds in downtown Philadelphia, killing at least six and injuring many others. They were out in South Street, just having dinner, enjoying their Saturday night. Their lives were senselessly cut short — and by multiple shooters! We are held hostage by the inability of our leaders to act on gun violence. We need change now. March for Our Lives is working to make it happen. They are policy-based and community-rooted and call for safety — grounded in the perspectives of gun violence survivors and their families, and bolstered by policy analysis and conversation. They are working to fight underlying forces that fuel gun violence. And we’re standing with them this week — and always. Join the movement this Saturday! Friend, I’d like to share with you the story of the NDRC: How we got our start, what we’ve accomplished so far, and all that we still have left to do in order to defend our democracy.

**It’s an incredible story that supporters like you should be proud of —[ _but if you don’t have time to read it and you’d rather just make a donation to support the NDRC’s mission, you can do so here._](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46283601/349599282/1746263042?amount=20&refcode=20220608.2r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ1ZDQxYTczLTYxZTctZWMxMS1iNjU2LTI4MTg3OGI4NTExMCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=HLBlUTM1ZIAzaw49HyS-F_LHwJXKTulCNoiwRRvV-8o=)** | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46283603/349599283/1746263042?amount=20&refcode=20220608.2r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ1ZDQxYTczLTYxZTctZWMxMS1iNjU2LTI4MTg3OGI4NTExMCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=HLBlUTM1ZIAzaw49HyS-F_LHwJXKTulCNoiwRRvV-8o=)

In 2011, Republicans manipulated the maps – and even though Democrats won the 2012 congressional popular vote by 1.4 million votes, the GOP won 33 more seats in the U.S. House. This was fundamentally unfair, and we could see that gerrymandering was obstructing the progressive legislation desired by the majority of Americans. Clearly, something had to be done.

So, in 2017, we launched the NDRC. And from the beginning, we made a big impact with targeted investments to help elect Democrats who would fight for fair maps. On Election Day 2018, fair-map candidates won at the ballot box, along with redistricting reforms that Republicans are _still_ fighting to this day.
[PITCH IN TO HELP US KEEP MAKING A DIFFERENCE](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46283605/349599285/1746263042?amount=20&refcode=20220608.2r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ1ZDQxYTczLTYxZTctZWMxMS1iNjU2LTI4MTg3OGI4NTExMCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=HLBlUTM1ZIAzaw49HyS-F_LHwJXKTulCNoiwRRvV-8o=)
---
In 2019 and 2020, we continued to support fair-map candidates while also defending the freedom to vote amidst a coordinated GOP push to pass voter suppression laws that targeted communities of color and hurt all voters. And when the redistricting cycle began again in 2021, we placed the spotlight on map manipulation and mobilized activists against GOP gerrymandering all over the country.

Thanks to our work, the maps that are in place are far more fair than they would have been if Republicans had been allowed to gerrymander unchecked. But even now, there are court cases pending and elections coming up that will have a big impact on the maps of the future and the gains we’ve already made. So the fight isn’t over – we have a lot more to do and **we can’t afford to get complacent.**

Since our launch, the NDRC has been successful thanks to the generous support of [_grassroots donors like you._](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46283606/349599286/1746263042?amount=20&refcode=20220608.2r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ1ZDQxYTczLTYxZTctZWMxMS1iNjU2LTI4MTg3OGI4NTExMCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=HLBlUTM1ZIAzaw49HyS-F_LHwJXKTulCNoiwRRvV-8o=) That hasn’t changed. So I’m concluding by asking: **Friend, will you pitch in today to support our ongoing work for fair redistricting?**

It’s an incredible story that supporters like you should be proud of —= | = = In 2011, Republicans manipulated the maps – and even though Democrats won the 2012 congressional popular vote by 1.4 million votes, the GOP won 33 more seats in the U.S. House. This was fundamentally unfair, and we could see that gerrymandering was obstructing the progressive legislation desired by the majority of Americans. Clearly, something had to be done. So, in 2017, we launched the NDRC. And from the beginning, we made a big impact with targeted investments to help elect Democrats who would fight for fair maps. On Election Day 2018, fair-map candidates won at the ballot box, along with redistricting reforms that Republicans are still fighting to this day. = In 2019 and 2020, we continued to support fair-map candidates while also defending the freedom to vote amidst a coordinated GOP push to pass voter suppression laws that targeted communities of color and hurt all voters. And when the redistricting cycle began again in 2021, we placed the spotlight on map manipulation and mobilized activists against GOP gerrymandering all over the country. Thanks to our work, the maps that are in place are far more fair than they would have been if Republicans had been allowed to gerrymander unchecked. But even now, there are court cases pending and elections coming up that will have a big impact on the maps of the future and the gains we’ve already made. So the fight isn’t over – we have a lot more to do and we can’t afford to get complacent. Since our launch, the NDRC has been successful thanks to the generous support of = That hasn’t changed. ### _Thank you._
To my team - Amy, Alex, Caleb for working (without exaggeration) every day for the last 6 months. To the donors, volunteers, supporters and voters. And to my family. Thank you.

We’re painfully far from the outcome we worked for but even more aware of just how much must be done to fix politics, our party, state, and nation. Our goal, and more importantly the change we need may be beyond this election but it is not beyond our control. Get out, get involved, vote.

Congratulations to our Republican nominee Tom Kean Jr., his team, and supporters. Excited to see this seat flipped, eager to support, and encouraging everyone who was behind us to do the same this fall.

JHI

subject: Mike DeWine says he’s the most anti-choice governor
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Whaley/Stephens
body:
While DeWine bragged about being the most anti-choice governor in the country, Nan Whaley fought to keep a Dayton abortion center open. It’s clear whose leadership we need to protect our rights after Roe.

Team,
**FIRST** : We found out that the Supreme Court plans to overturn _Roe_ any day now, letting abortion bans that Mike DeWine supported immediately become law.
**THEN:** Ohio Republicans got even more extreme, proposing new bills that would criminalize abortion care and let private citizens take legal action against people who provide and seek abortions.
**NOW:** Protecting abortion rights in Ohio means we have to elect a pro-choice governor. But that can only happen if we meet our goals for our big June 10 filing deadline.

name: Andy Ngo
subject: We can’t let them get away with this…
body:
I was one of the first civilians savagely beaten by lawless Antifa thugs. And unless we do something to stop them today, I'
[View this message in your browser](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zsgl6ll1ghtv48veiuuu6pcus6nsn7p8rjpt8e1o_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkir39tdkmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbo69d36m4o71ob4s1p34cdkslrmec9imdin9p5l69r6dd70elhbdcrl6mqedcr0sv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i6hj32t5jcko74cb666ob4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp238h1e8he4933clgmep37cli6aoh5u)
The mob was angry and looking for a fight.

| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zrebjq8jcskdrgrrsuj4mljvuc87f2o5o8u8qckg_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cti6epb4clh2bs)
My fellow concerned American,

I was one of the first civilians savagely beaten by lawless Antifa thugs.

And unless we do something to stop them today, I'll be far from the last.

[**That's why I'm asking you to donate $35 or more today to help me fund my landmark lawsuit that will bring Antifa and their members to justice.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z15n5h2a9r1eq99ru9mbve1sq97dqj3b1rj29vkg_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cti6epb4clh2bs)

**You see, I was at Antifa's "ground zero" in the summer of 2019.**

This was before most Americans had ever heard of the Antifa movement, but they'd caused havoc before.

I went to an Antifa "protest" as a journalist, to document and report on the event.

As soon as I arrived, I feared for my safety.

The mob was angry and looking for a fight.

Most of them wore masks -- and not the kind we're forced today because of coronavirus. They wanted to act like criminals without getting caught. Many had on helmets and makeshift armor. Some carried weapons like metal pipes, chains, crowbars, and even bricks.

I was scared, but I had a job to do, so I pressed on.

**People like you needed to know what was happening.**

But I didn't go unnoticed for long.

Somebody recognized me and jeers quickly rose through the crowd.

"F*** you, Andy Ngo!" and "Go home, fascist!"

I tried to escape, but it was too late.

**Projectiles started flying. Then came the fists.**

Before I knew it, I was being punched, kicked, and hit with flying objects.

I tried to protect my head, but I did not strike back as I knew that would only escalate the situation and put me in more danger.

Not to mention they stole my camera.

What they did to me is unacceptable. But this last summer, it became much worse than I could've ever imagined as Antifa set fire to entire cities for weeks on end.

**And now, we're watching Antifa and similar groups threaten mass riots and violence across the country.**

[**Will you donate $35 or more to help me cover the costs of my lawsuit against Antifa?**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zm2iv5vmffmeq42ipvseggucdgo2khrkga2e9fuo_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cti6epb4clh2bs)

This is bigger than me alone.

You see, after I got away from the mob, police finally showed up to question me, but my attackers stole all my evidence.

Later, cell phone footage from a bystander surfaced online. Thank goodness! The video captured the attack, clear as day.

I hoped I'd get the justice I deserved.

Wrong.

To this day, over a year later, my attackers are walking free. Portland police did nothing.

No charges.

No convictions

No justice.

It's not much of a surprise, though.

You see, radical politicians have long-since bowed to the dangerous mob that terrorizes their streets.

And now, as you and I are watching Antifa's nationwide takeover, more and more politicians across the country are following suit.

It's so bad that the justice system is buckling under the pressure of threats of violence from these disgusting thugs.

We have to stop them and make them face real, legal consequences for their destructive actions before they get to you and your family.

[**That's why I hope you'll join in the fight by donating $35 or more to fund my landmark lawsuit against Antifa and their members.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zptq40oge165ivfhrp6incmnnmtl6d9akas56i7o_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cti6epb4clh2bs)

Because Antifa wants the end of America as we know it -- and they'll stop at nothing to get it. Believe me when I say that's not an overstatement.

Some members are avowed socialists or communists. But many are much worse – open anarchists who want to tear down our society and remake it in their own twisted vision.

By any means necessary.

**_Rioting. Destruction. Mayhem._**

And they know, as long as they choose politically favored protests to co-opt, the media and politicians will never have the guts to denounce their violence or hold them accountable.

It's a sick strategy, but very smart – because so far, they've been right!

**For the most part, they've gotten off scot-free. **

Our politicians and media are treating this deranged terrorist group like peaceful protestors!

As we've seen, their riots will only spread and intensify if Antifa continues to escape consequences.

**So now I'm taking justice into my own hands – with the help of the talented lawyers at the Center for American Liberty.**

And, as I mentioned, we're suing Portland's Antifa Chapter. We've made a lot of progress in this case, but we're far from victory.

[**You can be a part of bringing Antifa to justice with a donation of $35 or more today.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zs382rng588805kid8rqf80b35m8ei6kmlbgtsgg_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cti6epb4clh2bs)

Though I'm seeking justice for myself, the impact of this case could be so much larger.

This is about standing up for our country when our own leaders won't. This is about saving America as we know it and keeping you and your family safe.

And this is just the first blow we intend to deliver.

By taking them to court for the attack against me we can prove they are NOT untouchable.

[**Can I count on you to donate $35 or more to fund this critical lawsuit?**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zv3a1p3qk78aa01mhj9v1bftr7j7cahitskkmdco_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cti6epb4clh2bs)

Please don't wait – if we don't fight back and win now, these violent thugs will be in EVERY city across America, destroying everything and everyone in their path.

Thank you in advance for your support.

**Sincerely,**

[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zrp60o64i3auie3oohjmqltduj5oq1u39fc22rdg_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cti6epb4clh2bs) [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zkku94dipv113187l8705t5flaq34og1n3ep0jdo_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cti6epb4clh2bs)

**Andy Ngo**
Investigative Journalist

P.S. I know firsthand that America's troubles with Antifa aren't over-- **_they're just beginning._** Today, we can make them face the consequences that left-wing politicians refuse to dole out.

[**Please donate as generously as you can right away.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z4bbnamv4k7jo251tk07ptqi0iit97u55rla2gpo_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cti6epb4clh2bs)

Friend, Less than three weeks remain until the June 28th primary election and our campaign has a tremendous amount of momentum. In our last "From the Trail" e-blast, I talked about the NBC Chicago debate. Last week, ABC Chicago held a forum with all six Republican governor candidates. The feedback from this forum is tremendously positive. One Illinois political analyst went so far as to say that "Schimpf outclasses the entire bunch." You can watch that ABC debate by clicking on the picture below.
[](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/r?u=SgNyPLzZf3rNdtpiQSh4sdNqxKNCGmWW7gWGxIw6oUBKKhc3357PJH3B2DLwaGBzTEeFlpAoeGiUGt8Q5xfBYTxJMsgrJIkiJn4re_oFp1MWhxJX7OqzCoJ4_W0OAZXN96g0VUiiUT41Vy97B8IVUstl0EFJa0BtpL5drMZHmaDKwatLtMAW1TrY2kM8VcWprgDpZmXFBmEQfRZ7Bs0lfNS_Z0K_PVQ2eyuxv4z7I-M6gD_5op7V0LeMW4pbimCd&e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=june_8th_eblast&n=2) It wasn't just the ABC debate that gave our campaign a boost. We also received the endorsement of the Chicago Tribune. This is the biggest political endorsement in the state of Illinois. You can read the Tribune endorsement by clicking on the picture of the Tribune below.
[](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/r?u=HkTArpYoFmU_GhK8KgLuiGi6R6IZz4GZffkVx90ar1QRWx2Jl44OWIkveJPzW_tf69R5b2C8gX1cuZxJQ8oTMBTsvI4daQOfdbWFpNcWpdjzwkvERT1I107Xw9xVw5baqhaic9zkCU68suqEmCah9zCir4MJHBkzfwfnlypbjjT5vRLNMU-aPHAWqv5-Cm7Dcb6ETgzhupKpvrXkqTHd1s0MtwbBsjwt8ng8lfIU7YQ&e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=june_8th_eblast&n=3)

* * *
**Campaign Advertising
** We were able to capitalize on the Chicago Tribune endorsement and immediately produce our fourth commercial. Thanks to your support and a donor match, we were able to raise over $50K in just three days. That means that the commercial below is running on digital and cable TV across Illinois as you read this! If you haven't already seen this commercial, you can watch it by clicking on the picture below.
[](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRZChv-FRcQQwr-uPLTmvwyh&e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=june_8th_eblast&n=4)
This is our final commercial before the June 28th primary. If you want to help get it seen by more people--you can donate to our campaign by clicking [HERE](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/donate?e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=june_8th_eblast&n=5).
* * *
**Upcoming Event** If you are in northern Illinois, please consider coming to our Wine & Cheese Tasting in Sycamore on June 16th. If you'd like to purchase tickets or sponsorships for our Wine & Cheese Tasting, you can do so by clicking [HERE](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_3Lj6RajSv5qRdK4rMJWZ6nr6zmCne4pdvg35i35sQYlMpx-9nSHBadRRPO-I0QPf1h0XY6tKshNEQWzZxwa1qzqY_jXEjtcXNNR3P59k_mzpGTEdFKWKg402ZaVRFeMLw&e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=june_8th_eblast&n=6).

* * *
**Issue Spotlight: Term Limits
** Elected office is a temp job--not a career. As voters, we deserve candidates who are committed to the office they are running for. That's why I didn't run for re-election as a state senator. In 2020, I felt I had no business running for re-election when I was trying to become a federal judge.
As your governor, I will support and sign legislation that establishes term limits in Illinois. I will also limit myself to serving two terms.
Thank you for reading this e-blast. Please encourage your friends and family to vote in the June 28th Republican Primary for the Schimpf-Schofield team! Semper Fidelis, Paul

Peter, I know it’s an election year and everything but... The political distraction tactics are getting out of hand.
* Americans are dealing with record-high gas prices...
* Inflation that just won't quit...
* And local schools going WILD with indoctrination efforts and parents who are repeatedly silenced!

Instead of focusing on these issues, we’ve got politicians making the pettiest attacks I’ve ever seen. _That’s GOT to end. We’ve got to focus on real issues._ **_[I AGREE: STAND WITH RAND >> ](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=489f6c73ab5c4572b500d5aa86181e7b&_e=NIi6k1eyhywD_Zw3YCmpxghcXPJYeXQEP7NgjW-oD5Y8-yKpUZ-_dKXilFL8gd9b9GkUXJm_o28AF8AFqdRHlXRn555F3SzWYyRKl5p7uT3PelpBCMB6WBmEGykVFqcQnwg6CbvclxlU-zo5pRLH50Je74MUeKOvLNBAyuUs3UQg0tNOZ3uojymycuLSL6KxZhyMz52H2hTEsIsdexjEOQ7cu4H_MH_LAYP2Xi5GWSKoVD5bqmrNAA6oPAhyv_fUs8v3JV85HxChhndjFOmgmK51QbRpNR40lc1tvQgbbjDtxx7WmHmPX3err7mPT6cISRbZTGGT1IivUhXdc0FUxqrRDWhT_fq9qMTHIN3qcSRP-VjfG3immuUcsBx7vCVjGzJ1rbsbHKjTiuNWLcYO4eMCLwWFt5rPb2t5F4z-0sA_NHxJampEFQmeb9tzKBji)_** Peter, it’s almost unreal to see the politics shift like this. We literally have parents struggling to buy baby formula right now and our president cannot articulate a solution at all. I’ve fought for more responsible spending to end the inflation bubble. I’ve repeatedly supported American energy to bring gas prices down and promote American security. I’ve defended parents and have a bill on the floor right now to help families have access to the formula they need. _I will always support the American people - with real solutions - over these pathetic attempts to get the spotlight for a minute. _ And if you ask me, we could use more of that in the Senate. | | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.

name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: Coming directly to you seeking feedback
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=iird7eCdiIoCI1VAzllCGNf54eibM9GX&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend,
The days and weeks ahead will be critical for the future of our country:
* Any day now, the U.S. Supreme Court is likely to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , setting reproductive freedom back decades.
* Serious talks - with Republican participation - are finally underway in the Senate to pass gun violence prevention legislation that will begin to make a difference saving lives.

Yet Senate Democrats - including me - are facing an onslaught of political attacks from a Republican Party that knows that it only needs to flip one Democratic seat to put Mitch McConnell back in control of the Senate.
That's why my campaign is ramping up our efforts. These next several weeks are _critical_ to protecting this seat and addressing the urgent issues our country faces, which is why **I 'm coming directly to you seeking feedback that will help our strategy. **
**[Input from grassroots Democrats like you is essential to creating the kind of country we want to live in, so I'm asking directly: Will you please take just a moment to let me know what issues matter most to you? We just opened this new survey and are counting on 150 responses before midnight.](http://surveys.signforgood.com/blumenthal-june-prio-2022?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500&code=jtk1192-su-nd)**
I know that you hear from me a lot about the stakes of defending Senate control - but the urgency of preventing a Republican majority is crystal clear. GOP elected officials in the Senate, House, and across the country are calling for a _national abortion_ ban. They have forestalled any progress on action to reduce gun violence and save lives while continuing to accept _millions_ from the gun lobby.
Their agenda is extreme, dangerous, and not representative of the majority of Americans' priorities. **But my willingness to stand up against the Republican Party has made me a target. I know that the only way I can ensure the balance of power in the Senate is with the best possible campaign strategy - powered by people like you.**
**[So please, will you share your feedback on our newest strategy? We have a number of campaign strategy meetings coming up this week, and I want to make sure that this grassroots team's thoughts are well reflected. ](http://surveys.signforgood.com/blumenthal-june-prio-2022?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500&code=jtk1192-su-nd)**
Thank you,
Dick

name: Gisele Barreto Fetterman
subject: Hi there, I’m the SLOP!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
This is a longer email from me, but I hope you read it
#
Hi Derek,
Our campaign has grown quickly since John won the Democratic primary for U.S. Senate, but I wanted to take a minute to introduce myself, in case we haven’t met yet.
I’m Gisele Barreto Fetterman, the Second Lady of Pennsylvania. Or, as I like to call myself, the SLOP. 😂
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220608-1?refcode=em20220608-6092&refcode2=6092_434096_XTg-YP&akid=6092%2E434096%2EXTg-YP)
_Here I am on Election Night filling in for João._
This is the story of me and John — but it gets a little long. **[If you don’t have the time to read this all right now, please consider making a donation of any amount towards our campaign today. No amount is too little to make a difference.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220608-1?refcode=em20220608-6092&refcode2=6092_434096_XTg-YP&akid=6092%2E434096%2EXTg-YP)**
I met John many years, three kids, and two dogs ago — before he was Pennsylvania’s next senator. Back then, he was just a guy trying to pour love into Braddock, a small steel town that helped build America, but had been left behind. He moved there to teach GED classes, and after two of his students were gunned down, he ran for mayor to stop the violence and bring back jobs.
I read about the work John was doing, and I was inspired. Long story short? I joined him in Braddock, he fell madly in love with me, we got married, and we’ve been working together ever since to make sure no one is left behind.
But really, though. I immigrated to this country with my mom when I was just a kid. I was a DREAMer. And when our son August heard that, he asked me: “Mommy, what did you dream about?” 😭
I told him: I dreamt about him. And that was true. But also, **I dreamt about all of this.**
Like so many others, I found the American dream, and made my life in Western Pennsylvania. I found love, a wonderful family, and a place I am proud to raise my children. **John and I want to make sure that everyone in Pennsylvania can find the American dream here, too.**
On the surface, John and I don’t seem like we’d have a lot in common. (According to the zodiac we are only 11% compatible — of course I checked!)
But what connected us then — and what connects us now — is a shared conviction: **no person should be left behind, and no community should be forgotten.**
John has always stood out. My grandmother Bibi used to say he had to be made that tall because it was the only way to fit his whole heart. ❤️
But it’s not just his height, his goatee, or his refusal to wear long pants — even when I beg him to — that make him different. It’s not just because John looks nothing like a politician (and is deliriously handsome, but don’t tell him I said that).
It’s because John doesn’t _act_ like a politician. At heart, he's still that hardworking, scrappy, small-town mayor. He wants to know the people he’s serving. He feels a responsibility to each and every one of them. And he fights for people like he’d fight for a neighbor, like he’d fight for our family.
**That is what makes John different. And that is what makes him tough enough to fight for Pennsylvania.**
He did it in Braddock. He did it in Harrisburg. And now, he’s going to do the same thing in Washington.
Now, I’m going to be honest with you. Politics is mean — and I’m not. But the truth is, too many people in this commonwealth and this country are hurting. Too many people feel abandoned and ignored. Too many people think their best days are behind them. Nothing is more cruel than the feeling of being hopeless.
But John has a plan and a purpose to make sure Pennsylvania’s best days are ahead of us.
He’s going to fight for abortion rights.
He’s going to fight to raise the minimum wage and protect the union way of life.
He’s going to fight to protect our planet.
He’s going to fight to eliminate the filibuster.
He’s going to fight to legalize cannabis.
He’s going to fight against gun violence.
He’s going to fight against inflation and corporate greed.
And he’s going to fight so this country starts making things in America again — the way it once did in Braddock.
Of course, the general election is less than six months away. And because Pennsylvania is our #1 chance to pick up a Democratic seat in the Senate, this race will likely be the biggest, most competitive, and most watched race in the country. (It’s already the most expensive! 🤯)
_But it might also be the nastiest._
Now that John’s officially the Democratic nominee, there’s going to be more dark money, more negative ads, more lies spread about him than most of us can imagine.
It could even start tomorrow.
Fortunately, John is up to the challenge. But he can’t do it alone.
**He needs your help to fight back.**
**[So please, if you can, please make a donation of any amount today to support John’s campaign for U.S. Senate. John has always had our backs — now it’s time we have his.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220608-1?refcode=em20220608-6092&refcode2=6092_434096_XTg-YP&akid=6092%2E434096%2EXTg-YP)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220608-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220608-6092&refcode2=6092_434096_XTg-YP&akid=6092%2E434096%2EXTg-YP)**
This race we’re running — it’s a race for the future of every community across Pennsylvania. For every small town, for every person who calls those small towns home, and for every person who’s considered leaving because they just didn’t see enough opportunities.
It’s a race for every job that’s been lost, for every factory that’s been closed, for every cost that keeps rising, and every worker who can’t keep up.
It’s a race for a better Pennsylvania, a better country.
And it’s a race that, together, we will win in November!
Thank you for taking the time to read this. Your support means the world to me, John, our family, and this whole campaign.
With love and gratitude,
Gisele ❤️
Gisele Barreto Fetterman
Second Lady of Pennsylvania (SLoP)
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220608-1?refcode=em20220608-6092&refcode2=6092_434096_XTg-YP&akid=6092%2E434096%2EXTg-YP)
P.S. **[Don’t miss your chance to say you were a proud supporter of this campaign from the very beginning by making a donation today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220608-1?refcode=em20220608-6092&refcode2=6092_434096_XTg-YP&akid=6092%2E434096%2EXTg-YP)**

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220608-6092-footer&t=1&refcode2=6092_434096_XTg-YP&akid=6092%2E434096%2EXTg-YP)**

[](https://www.facebook.com/JohnFettermanPA/) | [](https://twitter.com/johnfetterman) | [](https://www.instagram.com/johnfetterman/)
Email us: info@johnfetterman.com
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end. Small donors like you keep us going. To contribute via check, please address to Fetterman for PA, PO Box 6061, Pittsburgh PA 15211.

* [Update My Personal Information](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/personal_info/?t=2&akid=6092%2E434096%2EXTg-YP)

And he’s going to fight so this country starts making things in America again — the way it once did in Braddock. Of course, the general election is less than six months away. And because Pennsylvania is our #1 chance to pick up a Democratic seat in the Senate, this race will likely be the biggest, most competitive, and most watched race in the country. (It’s already the most expensive! 🤯) But it might also be the nastiest. Now that John’s officially the Democratic nominee, there’s going to be more dark money, more negative ads, more lies spread about him than most of us can imagine. It could even start tomorrow. Fortunately, John is up to the challenge. But he can’t do it alone. He needs your help to fight back. This race we’re running — it’s a race for the future of every community across Pennsylvania. For every small town, for every person who calls those small towns home, and for every person who’s considered leaving because they just didn’t see enough opportunities. It’s a race for every job that’s been lost, for every factory that’s been closed, for every cost that keeps rising, and every worker who can’t keep up. It’s a race for a better Pennsylvania, a better country. And it’s a race that, together, we will win in November! Thank you for taking the time to read this. Your support means the world to me, John, our family, and this whole campaign. With love and gratitude, Gisele ❤️ Gisele Barreto Fetterman Second Lady of Pennsylvania (SLoP) P.S. | | Email us: info@johnfetterman.com

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zfu4nl274dnni0kh7ihm3jrkqjmtcajo96a9tdbo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk5p7atdge5p78d5jmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbpb1p1hcsob6tdk65r39cj46mrrbclmeorb4tbnm5qn1dpkmhhmacrhm1qn1ctgcv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i6hj32s5jc1jr5cr66aob4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp238h1e8he4933clgmeoj0c9j69oh5u)
This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9n8d9nlpdp4k5sfljgvkopdbts44gk2m45gb5dg_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cth60oj6cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0tt4qbauda8es8o7i18pga1fm3kikeouprb55m8_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cth60oj6cjh2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ztn2l7clvi7s66t1n80cbmm7tulbkmsr1torkt40_rp22sh2s8i66pb1cth60oj6cjh2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Despite the outcome, it’s clear that working Montanans overwhelmingly support the popular progressive policies we fight for. | | | [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953xzKJRBFYnnGuurjHNF501U9NIW8wL-3T4jNirG9BHycCAPCizznKiPZv4uInGRmJr7XBVaIsgjVb0na2fG7qu9SNfrW99uI5aaKbu9Ia2QFKscQ4GIRRzfQmcti1AVXmScj6abuVVakaWPcFyCehDpMVpSgHjxM5Z8IB562OWOKEKq2CZCVTrcAFNRMLDoD56epTS3MX4YuLbgKKXH3fk0ULtO0sE0pTYMTggNNBvYm9fgIFaJqi3DO-XwH3o8YDtkKcWGpibeeRWf0Ih4LBqh9iD3lylmYCeuxm0TQkgNSxp7Hhfrz_K2znChjpVsPhI/3mq/APhDJRtsRL-FaIpaGz3ewQ/h0/-7sgTQ3DwFTT0SQaIB1OO5r2Jo8hdIYe5jg6JfrmIHE) Friends,

Let me begin by saying thank you from the bottom of my heart for supporting our campaign. Although we did not come out on top tonight, I am so proud of the work we’ve done together.

Together, our campaign fought for what’s right even when it was difficult – issues like universal health care no matter your income, the right to an abortion, affordable housing, a living wage, and making billionaires and corporations pay their fair share of taxes. We never compromised our Montana values in order to appease rich and powerful interests. The integrity of the people of Montana has inspired us to be better public servants.

**Despite the outcome, it’s clear that working Montanans overwhelmingly support the popular progressive policies we fight for. The only thing preventing structural reforms is our broken political system corrupted by money that only serves the rich.**

One thing I am incredibly proud of is our grassroots campaign model: Together, we engaged thousands of Montanans across the political spectrum thanks to the hundreds of Montanans we activated as organizers in their communities.

**Our campaign may have fallen short in votes but the strength of the policies and Montana values we pushed for is no less true today.** Now, it’s time to move forward and unite behind Monica Tranel. I encourage you to visit her [website](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/tTBUZwcBH_2q13Ow12s-jT0BYEmc57kdEcKDc_zqVtZxJqe_x1HQLyMCIb-UaDsdJNQGKBz2IIUYjZhaN1nz52Nui4RZM8Xk0rEe8zYtzyojtcOhsYf5RmLiIAqLHD_QOxaG231GcYRfvYQsn2XmYwbffDsmUiGEdUeLmo8OzaQnmWcOM_zTVTd2YGmipA2fprhR7rcdT4T3zSuOpDNnTbN4ee1mdjl1TsS4-bfqzF1LxIRjrNkXdf89OIvscI5QWnopHjYQC-0JxHd17wmp2g/3mq/APhDJRtsRL-FaIpaGz3ewQ/h1/13xqUTYfDRp5KdyWIa1aH-FPN929W2xmCsRgXYnlrz4) and support her campaign in whichever way works best for you.

Working Montanans cannot afford Ryan Zinke’s outright corruption – and we cannot afford to send him back to Congress. Together, we must get Montana’s politics working for the people again.

In Solidarity,
Tom

| | | **Amanda Makki Launches “Community Conservatives Unite” Video Touting the Groundswell of Republican Support for Her Campaign in FL-13 ** Hello Friend!

Today, we launch our “Community Conservatives Unite” video highlighting Amanda’s growing grassroots support in the district, including the endorsements of 13 Pinellas County mayors. Amanda has been identified as the _Community Conservative_ in this race, based on her growing number of district Dash-based endorsements from leading Conservatives.
“ _I am proud to have the support of so many Republican mayors and grassroots activists in this campaign,” Makki stated. “It demonstrates that our message of filling Charlie Crist’s empty chair in Congress with a conservative fighter is resonating with the Republican primary voters in this district. Together, we will turn this seat red, we will return a Republican majority to the House of Representatives, and will fire Nancy Pelosi for good.” _ _“As we continue canvassing the district and attending numerous weekly events, our message continues to resonate that my campaign and candidacy is one that is unapologetically pro-life, pro-DeSantis, pro-term limits, and pro-2nd Amendment.” “We’ll continue to work hard every day to get this message to the voters.”_

We are asking all our friends and supporters to post it and share it on their social media platforms - Facebook, YouTube, Twitter, Instagram - so everyone knows there’s only one Community Conservative in this race who will fight for us in Congress!

Amanda would be so grateful for your support so we can help spread the word about Amanda, get yard signs and bumper stickers out and do everything we need to make sure Amanda wins!

| | | | | Blake Masters for Senate | June 8, 2022

| The Rundown
---
| Welcome to The Rundown! Here's your monthly update from Blake Masters' campaign & a roundup of our national media coverage.
Counting down: We're exactly five months out from the General Election.
---
| | [Visit our Website](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nxmcvZIYsgrgzHkvC_sIw83az5jsyalk88-7zbFPSoNKlsrxDNpuM4iKJWgI0EBXjJ1F2e26-GSXLFMA0H-ACiENYbs0L97IMCU2uHabzbmgqCaek4wb10Z4FEBc0Uv8J030rtbmfMkeCazy3kodAQ==&c=71kcCClRAMfv0XfwdI6A6ABpSl05vmu9raYfmIhLsR1Uy90Mr7AtFw==&ch=O9lKmddX2foj6d9KeZYmm8TyJ5RbTljnEJLSf6f0CHfJblF6L1mTdQ==)

| |

| From the Trail
---
Blake has surged into the lead!
It was a huge month. Blake received President Donald Trump's endorsement. Blake also participated in several debates, spoke at dozens of events, and was featured in many media interviews.
Blake continues to build his lead, as we race toward the August 2 primary.
---
| |
---
A huge turnout at this Yuma meet and greet -- Blake also toured a local farm and food bank in his time by the border.
---
---
The campaign hosted a high energy event in Chandler last month!
---
| |
---
Blake fielded questions at this Payson Tea Party event. Afterwards, multiple attendees said he had won their support!
---
---
The Maricopa Young Republicans are a group Blake meets with regularly.

| |

| Endorsements
President Trump endorses Blake
[President Trump endorsed Blake](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nxmcvZIYsgrgzHkvC_sIw83az5jsyalk88-7zbFPSoNKlsrxDNpuMyvWMPKnBju5AbNLWMnDs5rptb8Xg4OGInRxGHytQ-1bG6sRfijmGI3pjkDwUrl-pWvFaQP3dE-IcbQkPmfgCATxUNA_G5-Rxu52eMYPAFbXpAYc5z9NHKSKVcGR-RVSWYhRKB62QEf_2MN_GzCilthp-YerYHxm7oLXSBeZdBXUxyyfo5tfkNFQl6jWGCcqeA==&c=71kcCClRAMfv0XfwdI6A6ABpSl05vmu9raYfmIhLsR1Uy90Mr7AtFw==&ch=O9lKmddX2foj6d9KeZYmm8TyJ5RbTljnEJLSf6f0CHfJblF6L1mTdQ==) in his race to represent Arizona in the U.S. Senate. Here's an excerpt from President Trump's statement:
"Blake is Strong on Border Security, in particular, the disastrous Southern Border where people are pouring into the U.S. by the millions, and destroying our Country ... Blake will turn that around quickly.
Additionally, he will Cut Taxes and Regulations, be Tough on Crime, and Support our Military and our Vets. Blake will fight for our totally under-siege Second Amendment, and WIN!"
---
| |
---
| New Video: They Call Me A Nationalist
---
Blake posted a new video, in which he argues our leaders should put America First. "The New York Times attacked me, they called me a 'nationalist.' Got me! Guilty as charged."

| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nxmcvZIYsgrgzHkvC_sIw83az5jsyalk88-7zbFPSoNKlsrxDNpuMyvWMPKnBju5QWlUyNxgt4d5T48d66Rjy0bE_uLxBd7mXZeCpq0vZwM3-pvlrLso2J-Rkmm5MUZUj56-rtUhoXz1N8lfG1i4QQ==&c=71kcCClRAMfv0XfwdI6A6ABpSl05vmu9raYfmIhLsR1Uy90Mr7AtFw==&ch=O9lKmddX2foj6d9KeZYmm8TyJ5RbTljnEJLSf6f0CHfJblF6L1mTdQ==)

| Major Media: Highlights
Blake joined [Tucker Carlson Tonight](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nxmcvZIYsgrgzHkvC_sIw83az5jsyalk88-7zbFPSoNKlsrxDNpuMyvWMPKnBju55Cu_X2c3bQmGScfoQQiIfYQ_LjB1J2dDPDQ5eBEyakgA_uS1fvgHdDdIsHgu2vewCMQF0WLSVMpiw68hY7W6Tw==&c=71kcCClRAMfv0XfwdI6A6ABpSl05vmu9raYfmIhLsR1Uy90Mr7AtFw==&ch=O9lKmddX2foj6d9KeZYmm8TyJ5RbTljnEJLSf6f0CHfJblF6L1mTdQ==) to discuss recent unethical attacks from the mainstream media. Tucker referred to Blake as the "real deal" and that's why he's facing these attacks.

Blake Masters spoke about the border, his race, inflation, and Mark Kelly on [Dan Bongino's radio show](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nxmcvZIYsgrgzHkvC_sIw83az5jsyalk88-7zbFPSoNKlsrxDNpuMyvWMPKnBju5_ap6_6qxbGUkYD_1RAvQbjEq0RQ4QjDhVdux6r2OtfuXWjd2N8vRq4NbpasrakIAP465ZflwXb-qhQuZPRypWw==&c=71kcCClRAMfv0XfwdI6A6ABpSl05vmu9raYfmIhLsR1Uy90Mr7AtFw==&ch=O9lKmddX2foj6d9KeZYmm8TyJ5RbTljnEJLSf6f0CHfJblF6L1mTdQ==).
On [Steve Bannon's War Room](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nxmcvZIYsgrgzHkvC_sIw83az5jsyalk88-7zbFPSoNKlsrxDNpuMyvWMPKnBju5MAZl53SDgZho4QIr7KeASS6O7SOOJsjjgOOkmI0PvwvUHIyxNWVu-cR3OZDNhZaDdFqI0EmttnlxY_gBxcR1SCJYJaBz9Hb6paUe_8i0T5mximtYaQCxJs5O8M0Pz6-7fji3Eax3Birn0tbJzd-zUw==&c=71kcCClRAMfv0XfwdI6A6ABpSl05vmu9raYfmIhLsR1Uy90Mr7AtFw==&ch=O9lKmddX2foj6d9KeZYmm8TyJ5RbTljnEJLSf6f0CHfJblF6L1mTdQ==), Blake discussed President Trump's endorsement and Jim Lamon's shady campaign tactics.
On Real America's Vice News Network, Blake joined John Solomon and Amanda Head to talk about the border crisis and President Trump's endorsement on [Just The News, Not Noise](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nxmcvZIYsgrgzHkvC_sIw83az5jsyalk88-7zbFPSoNKlsrxDNpuMyvWMPKnBju5dx7qYGFDnJxF7xFj06OXgRGwq7CkP5_E_QAsODVCFn22UxTYi7VcIYx20-06cAJuSd5YHYoE_Ams0axF5fxqO-uVOc8tcf33ITbr9uoKG5ewLJDw0lwf8kLwErOBon3-qqPVVb8wkfDW-Gf73szU8H_zowMHkDvZq8qygRACZ4MQFQVi8bIHovr0QQfCdLN77B5r_qIt0iURYaKHpb7-lgMQhYktXsssi70kOXinc0tPwqRxt8FxCHcy4G0HYt5KiecaR1hUY9neajT4l4HX3UC7swUpyI_urJdP1KOULDYkciHHUSU6zA==&c=71kcCClRAMfv0XfwdI6A6ABpSl05vmu9raYfmIhLsR1Uy90Mr7AtFw==&ch=O9lKmddX2foj6d9KeZYmm8TyJ5RbTljnEJLSf6f0CHfJblF6L1mTdQ==).

Blake Masters joined [America Right Now](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nxmcvZIYsgrgzHkvC_sIw83az5jsyalk88-7zbFPSoNKlsrxDNpuMyvWMPKnBju5G7xnqxkjlW9aW3qLmjJPDWY7xV-6363dNjJIrGE73FaylFBo8TwK3mU4kQJu_gL36Gayt7d1OkPifllHu45aY3rnRgOw0SHHwv8a3r2_2brCFrIq30gzPA==&c=71kcCClRAMfv0XfwdI6A6ABpSl05vmu9raYfmIhLsR1Uy90Mr7AtFw==&ch=O9lKmddX2foj6d9KeZYmm8TyJ5RbTljnEJLSf6f0CHfJblF6L1mTdQ==) on Newsmax to discuss the state of his race, the border, election integrity, and Mark Kelly

Over a career of nearly 50 years of media and journalism, I was fortunate to tell the stories of Utah. To travel from small towns to big cities, the halls of government and neighborhoods.

To me, people learn the stories of the past, the issues of the present, and how they will inform and grace the future of this great state.

That experience leads me to a simple conclusion.

"This year, for United States Senate, I'm supporting Ally Isom."

"Ally embodies the Utah Spirit. She carries the values of the Utah experience with her as she journeys through these towns and neighborhoods - getting to know you and the issues that will shape our future."

Her service to the state on the local level, at the state level, business and in her faith - demonstrates her commitment to representing our voice in Washington.

"If you're convinced the Utah voice needs to be heard, rooted in the Utah experience, join me in supporting Ally Isom."
|

We are always looking for patriotic Arizonans who want to take action in all corners of the state. Here are a few ways that you can directly help:
1. **Make phone calls** – contacting Arizonans is critical to our statewide operation and outreach efforts. These are the easiest way to ensure that voters in every county are aware of Brnovich’s proven conservative record and why he’s the best candidate to uphold Arizona values as a Senator!

4. **Place a yard sign** – this is a great way of expressing your support at the most localized level – your yard! If you have any friends/family/neighbors that also want one, they can request a sign here or by contacting us directly.

#
Hello Peter Willis,

It's Elizabeth "Liz" Johnson from lizjohnsonforus.com here and I want to start off by saying thank you for being here. I am so grateful for you.

If you're reading this, you probably don't know much about me.

Well, that is about to change! In this email, I will introduce myself and share access to some of my resources with you.

Here's a short bio about me: Elizabeth "LIZ" Johnson has been a Bulloch County resident for 26 years. Liz and her husband, a retired law enforcement officer, will celebrate their 25th anniversary within two weeks of the 2022 November General Election. Together they have seven adult children, seventeen grandchildren, and several great-grandchildren.

As a proven leader in her community, Liz has served as an elected officer, appointed board member, and committee chair of various organizations. She has served at the county, district, and state committee levels of the Democratic Party of Georgia for over 20 years as a political leader. In 2012, after being elected by her state committee peers, Liz also served as one of six Democratic National Committee members representing Georgia.

In 2022, Elizabeth ‘LIZ’ Johnson is again our Democratic Nominee for U.S. House of Representatives in Georgia’s 12th District on the November ballot.

You can read my full story on my Meet Liz page. Every once in a while, someone will inevitably email me to ask why they didn't get a particular email that their friend received in their inbox. Add me to your contact list or drag this email away from the promotions tab to ensure that you get all of my emails. I want to make sure that you receive all of the campaign updates and resources that I share with you.

If you're on Gmail, there is a drop-down arrow next to the big reply button. If you click that, the 5th option down says to "Add Liz Johnson to Contacts List."

Thank you! I am grateful to you, and have a great day ahead!

You'll hear from me again soon. This relationship is the start of something great, Peter Willis.

In my following email, I'll discuss why I started my political campaign and how it benefits you.

I am looking forward to taking this journey with you!

With much gratitude,
Elizabeth "Liz" Johnson
Lizjohnsonforus.com

Utah-native and the former Global President and Chief Customer Officer for Johnson & Johnson Consumer Products Jeff Strong first worked with Ally Isom years ago.

"What I saw was a great leader, a person that can communicate, that can collaborate, that can lead other people, that can work through difficult and complex issues."

As you take a look at Ally, you'll see what I see, which is a politician that will do a great job for the state of Utah. She doesn't see people that disagree with her as enemies. She sees them as opportunities to have dialogue and persuade them to support the things she thinks are important.

This upcoming election is critical. Change in Washington is necessary, and she is the type of politician that we desperately need right now.

"There is no question in my mind that she will be an outstanding senator."

I don't have to tell you how much is at stake in the November elections: Our reproductive rights. Our voting rights. Our health care. Our very democracy. But unless we defend each and every Democratic seat, we could lose our majority – and our chance to pass our bold agenda.
**That’s why I’m reaching out to you today. If we’re going to keep the Senate blue, we _must_ reelect Catherine, Maggie, Mark, and me – we have zero room for error. So I'm asking directly: [Please, will you give $5 or more right now to help us win our critical races and protect our majority?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46290512/349632665/1698898113?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1847-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YzNkMTJjOC03ZWU3LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=h5tHEx2bBSZ7hfX4jCqIYGsIANMbOuhqNYPU_NtiAFY=)**
