The Senate race in Georgia will go down to the wire. Democrats are going to spend whatever it takes to keep their politician in the Senate and maintain their razor-thin majority. Take a look at the panicked email they sent:

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=e772fbfdcc1f49f6a5d935953eda9851&_e=uCvpgMNcXEK95En9x0Upk1-T7k2ZSTvnn1iDCm5W8AxVkpodiAQYKScpWOMta4aeGBcvBe63D6mCQaGZqv3C9rhbqmx0vZ0_muErunL7g-yX51NCXs_fGWcuAsYrgji6uXG-AJSG_nsVaCdtxL4jKuNQtCoFGVBaBRt1SxrMeaWXAeM66Ga6rLikgKqp-E-oVMyQPDDv5bUKIHMWzGIR7PxCyBogHDh3wSoQ_ibxk79W9jxjPc1qYcN3S259RxcfKUYPvEDSajdPSgH_YVCDaNIscm5-JrNIDzAQ9naAJs0-CZzhtLTM3pO0z-AQf3sZhXbWSIh9XdhDyeW4ldfmd08-vdRDn4nOw2iYYuVpMJgt0WJQ8PXuwAHj9lh-Kj5nlD9wIP8_GfC1XD99HTL_0gT1X1VAHQgIl-ekuApYDqwwu5cSmnlC9zie7CBscxFedgPRzX1zL6aKw490qLoixB7cQP64QsOPb1KlbXECzDU%3D)
The Democrats are on a roll with their fundraising. Their supporters understand what's at stake - control of the U.S. Senate and the fate of the Biden-Schumer-Pelosi agenda. In Georgia, we're running against the #1 fundraising senator in the country who already has $23 million in his campaign war chest.

Our campaign is being aggressive in our fundraising, but we're behind our June goal - by a significant amount. We hate writing emails like this 5 months from Election Day, but **we must hit every fundraising goal along the way if we're going to have the necessary funds to win in November.**

**[In an effort to get back on course, we're asking 1,500 conservatives to make a donation of $10 or more before midnight tonight.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=e772fbfdcc1f49f6a5d935953eda9851&_e=uCvpgMNcXEK95En9x0Upk1-T7k2ZSTvnn1iDCm5W8AxVkpodiAQYKScpWOMta4aeGBcvBe63D6mCQaGZqv3C9rhbqmx0vZ0_muErunL7g-yX51NCXs_fGWcuAsYrgji6uXG-AJSG_nsVaCdtxL4jKuNQtCoFGVBaBRt1SxrMeaWXAeM66Ga6rLikgKqp-E-oVMyQPDDv5bUKIHMWzGIR7PxCyBogHDh3wSoQ_ibxk79W9jxjPc1qYcN3S259RxcfKUYPvEDSajdPSgH_YVCDaCfWeplYRd6hoQg6s0IhHG0I2sVJB51huTDUE2ZwlUEJrOkZh_pJEDUIuDOOg-qZfFs8LtwCKtiSgxaO2aITCp4QVDwZMNQZScXUMPbGoAbrhbxpWNr6lQY3QHBl9Td8IWFuDLADKxoLILCq2eRcyXzh6zharQa1xGl9K5h8dczG5p08gTYgl5VIPZPotULFgp_LmGL8cHLs60viMgumdmI%3D)**

### BREAKING: Florida Auditor General Confirms Charges by Whistleblower Rebekah Jones Against FL-DOH
Gross mismanagement of COVID-19 data, including “inaccurate,” “Incomplete,” and “delayed” reporting, put millions of Floridians at risk and undermined state’s efforts to fight the virus Two years after former Department of Health scientist Rebekah Jones told state officials she was asked to conceal and distort COVID-19 infection rates, the Florida Auditor General [confirms ](https://www.rebekahjonescampaign.com/so/f8O54iowY/c?w=Nycz7OKFOE82Z6Ui7wFG5CdpDzTEUg2Cmx4jP9EOuUA.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9mbGF1ZGl0b3IuZ292L3BhZ2VzL3BkZl9maWxlcy8yMDIyLTIwMC5wZGYiLCJyIjoiMWY0YzMwZjktYzMxOC00Y2VlLWE3NzQtOGE2MWRiMDc3MzU2IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiN2U3YTg3ZTEtNzA0My00MTc5LWI4MzgtNWNhODkyMGZhYWQ3In0)that Department of Health (DOH) and other entities provided “inaccurate or incomplete data,” lacked “effective access controls in the systems used to gather data,” and “impacted the State’s ability to accurately report COVID-19 data at the beginning of the pandemic.” Jones was terminated in May of 2020 after refusing to manipulate COVID-19 data as requested by her supervisors. Jones was the architect and manager of the DOH COVID-19 Data and Surveillance Dashboard, the primary resource by which Floridians could access the most accurate and up to date information. Jones subsequently filed a claim for wrongful termination with the Florida Commission of Human Relations (FCHR), where her case is still pending. Jones was afforded legal whistleblower protections in May 2021, a designation she still holds. Recent reporting on Jones’ case has distorted the status of her complaint based on a report issued by the Florida Department of Health Inspector General on May 26 (IG Report). The IG Report is extraneous to Jones’ formal complaint with the FCHR, and also wrong on the facts – contradicting its own evidence in the report. The primary allegations by Jones were that two different supervisors directed her to falsify COVID-19 positivity data in order to justify the state’s precipitous first-in-the-nation reopening plans. The report chronicles that three separate colleagues of Jones verified that she came to them in the immediate aftermath of her supervisors’ demands and relayed to them what happened. All three reports are consistent. However, the IG Report ultimately concluded that there was not enough evidence to support or reject the claim because the supervisors in question denied the claims of wrongdoing, and there were no witnesses to the conversations. In addition, the Report contradicts its own exhibits by stating that the metric Jones was told to manipulate did not exist – namely a 10% case rate positivity threshold for reopening counties. As the screenshot of the public dashboard Jones commanded demonstrates, the 10% threshold was absolutely a criterion, with text providing: Florida Health Metrics: The Re-Open Florida Task Force outlined the criteria shown here to evaluate each county’s readiness to begin a phased return to pre-pandemic activity:
* ED [emergency department] visits with influenza-like illness
* ED visits with COVID-like illness
* Documented new cases
* Percent positive for laboratory testing over time
* Percent positive for laboratory testing below 10%

The IG Report was widely and falsely reported as an exoneration of the State COVID-19 response, including the bizarre and illegal attacks of Governor DeSantis on Jones, including sending an armed police force to her home without a warrant during which officers pointed guns at her two young children. The Auditor General's report released this week flips the script, laying blame for the Governor’s tragic response squarely at the feet of his own appointees and agency staff. The finding that the State acted so recklessly lends credence to Jones’ account of the State’s ceaseless attempts to defame and discredit her, as aided by certain complicit media. It also further paves the way towards Jones’ coming litigation against the State, which will be possible after the Florida Commission on Human Relations issues a finding on her wrongful termination claim. That determination is a long time coming, evidently due to the Governor’s instructions to delay until after the next election. To add to an already victorious week for Jones, The Washington Post [broke a story today ](https://www.rebekahjonescampaign.com/so/f8O54iowY/c?w=ZQ08uMIJb7LcL-M393NyJScpNL5LX2G7uwwc48wi0dU.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cud2FzaGluZ3RvbnBvc3QuY29tL3BvbGl0aWNzLzIwMjIvMDYvMDgvY2hyaXN0aW5hLXB1c2hhdy1kZXNhbnRpcy1mb3JlaWduLWFnZW50LXNhYWthc2h2aWxpLyIsInIiOiIxZjRjMzBmOS1jMzE4LTRjZWUtYTc3NC04YTYxZGIwNzczNTYiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiI3ZTdhODdlMS03MDQzLTQxNzktYjgzOC01Y2E4OTIwZmFhZDcifQ)showing that Christina Pushaw, the DeSantis spokesperson who was criminally charged with repeatedly violating a restraining order Jones took out against her in April 2021, failed to register as a foreign agent, and faces a potentially lengthy prison sentence as a result. The state Audit and breaking news about Pushaw, who is one of the people who[ orchestrated a Twitter campaign to smear, harass, stalk and terrorize Jones,](https://www.rebekahjonescampaign.com/so/f8O54iowY/c?w=YpAn8D8ZtarU6LcmDYLB-euxDdAqShQl5XUlOb7a2MI.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9yZWJla2Foam9uZXMuc3Vic3RhY2suY29tL3AvdW5tYXNraW5nLXRoZS1jdWxwcml0cy1vZi10aGUtbWlzaW5mb3JtYXRpb24_cz13IiwiciI6IjFmNGMzMGY5LWMzMTgtNGNlZS1hNzc0LThhNjFkYjA3NzM1NiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjdlN2E4N2UxLTcwNDMtNDE3OS1iODM4LTVjYTg5MjBmYWFkNyJ9) in addition to [posing as a government official and creating a stalker/manifesto website with false and defamatory statements about Jones](https://www.rebekahjonescampaign.com/so/f8O54iowY/c?w=ZxYQjvabmCDzUhZfcjA5ocwIDm6NvwKjoB-jNq6Adv8.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9yZWJla2Foam9uZXMuc3Vic3RhY2suY29tL3AvYS1zdHJpa2luZ2x5LWhhcHB5LXlldC1zYWQtZGF5P3M9dyIsInIiOiIxZjRjMzBmOS1jMzE4LTRjZWUtYTc3NC04YTYxZGIwNzczNTYiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiI3ZTdhODdlMS03MDQzLTQxNzktYjgzOC01Y2E4OTIwZmFhZDcifQ), likely sparked the misinformation and fabricated stories by known DeSantis allies like Marc Caputo earlier this month. On May 12, 2021, DeSantis' administration coordinated with the alt-right online magazine, The National Review, to post [a false and defamatory article about Jones](https://www.rebekahjonescampaign.com/so/f8O54iowY/c?w=JxsUQhPJo7DSws2N7s8zMzMfwIqsb5ofERfo013nhic.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9yZWJla2Foam9uZXMuc3Vic3RhY2suY29tL3AvbmF0aW9uYWxpc3RyZXZpZXdzbWVhcj9zPXciLCJyIjoiMWY0YzMwZjktYzMxOC00Y2VlLWE3NzQtOGE2MWRiMDc3MzU2IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiN2U3YTg3ZTEtNzA0My00MTc5LWI4MzgtNWNhODkyMGZhYWQ3In0) based, according to the article, on the word of a single source. That source turned out to be a former-DOH employee William "Parker" Hinson. Hinson left DOH in 2018, after which time Jones took his job. He was not employed by DOH during the pandemic, had no role in the dashboard or access in any way to know how it worked, and has dedicated a disturbingly large amount of time over the last two years stalking and defaming Jones online. That fabricated National Review article came just two weeks before Jones [received official whistleblower protection ](https://www.rebekahjonescampaign.com/so/f8O54iowY/c?w=kaBLJK33FFp20z-setFQuoDOEizOe_IEykVzRYbBS7A.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubWlhbWloZXJhbGQuY29tL29waW5pb24vZWRpdG9yaWFscy9hcnRpY2xlMjUxNzgxMjczLmh0bWwiLCJyIjoiMWY0YzMwZjktYzMxOC00Y2VlLWE3NzQtOGE2MWRiMDc3MzU2IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiN2U3YTg3ZTEtNzA0My00MTc5LWI4MzgtNWNhODkyMGZhYWQ3In0)\- which the state had been informed was in the works earlier that month. Similarly, the state's audit report was initially sent to officials on May 26, 2022- the same day NBC's Marc Caputo reached out to Jones' lawyers for a quote on the confidential report that was leaked to him before it was even sent to Jones' legal team. Their failed attempts to distract the public and defame Rebekah Jones only further substantiate the vindictiveness of a Governor whose day of reckoning is very near on the horizon, solidifying Jones' place in Florida history as a hero for the people who stood up to a ruthless tyrant and walked away victorious.
### Very few candidates for public office have experienced the full weight of a corrupt regime's power and walked away stronger, smarter and better for it. That's the candidate Rebekah Jones is and it's why you should [support her campaign to defeat Matt Gaetz today.](https://www.rebekahjonescampaign.com/so/f8O54iowY/c?w=hoNkqYNzUIRt55Nw4NwseVSvDIS8SFOCon3-LK_nwzE.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUubnVtZXJvLmFpL2NvbnRyaWJ1dGUvUmViZWthaC1Kb25lcy1Db25ncmVzcyIsInIiOiIxZjRjMzBmOS1jMzE4LTRjZWUtYTc3NC04YTYxZGIwNzczNTYiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiI3ZTdhODdlMS03MDQzLTQxNzktYjgzOC01Y2E4OTIwZmFhZDcifQ)

Friend,
Monday was the deadline to submit a public comment calling on the EPA to strengthen the Cross-State Air Pollution Rule—**but luckily for us, they just extended the window.**
You might remember this as the "good neighbor rule"—the one that would save lives and reduce hospital visits by calling for upwind states to limit their pollution and protect downwind states.
This unexpected extension means we can make a bigger impact and send more comments in favor of expanding clean air protections. But it also means that Big Polluters could see our momentum and use the bonus time to try to drown us out.
**We saw you hadn't signed a public comment yet.[_Will you take one minute today to sign your name and call for stronger clean air provisions? We'll submit it directly to EPA decision-makers!_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4318?t=4&akid=12980%2E53494%2EBD00-0)**
[SIGN ON](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4318?t=5&akid=12980%2E53494%2EBD00-0)

Before we asked our grassroots team to step up, the EPA had only received 37 total comments on this rule. As of today, our team alone has sent in **3,219 official public comments.** We're setting a goal of submitting at least 2,000 more, and we need you with us.
**We can win this.[_Join thousands of your fellow climate advocates and take real, substantial action right now._](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4318?t=6&akid=12980%2E53494%2EBD00-0)**

subject: Thank you!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Penny Ronning for U
body:
TOGETHER we make a difference.
| | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-yyGSVuRGbCZVpWko4oj3YNkt9YLHcQ9RWP2aonCnX7ePKfPBl9PadXT5hjgdcU-GXoqfknaLGvp_m4jmCFdSZm8KXHdamsTWWDRwkjCH9GUhg9Ptk1rVW-HRB23xw4nlc9OUngQ0AxvJelWtbliIg==&c=aG4zodspmdABSwVVXwDcJC80qXzJ4vZHZpvyhCSYVkldjdifjvYe0w==&ch=bWp-YwlkCMzl1d5vztZeV51-WokYD0Yea9B8FJrWsXupLPWhJcFYPQ==)
---
| Thank You! TOGETHER we make a difference.
---
|
---
Dear Friends, With all of my heart, THANK YOU! THANK YOU!
Messages and calls continued to come late into the night and began again early this morning. I am deeply grateful to and for all of you. THANK YOU! An important phone call I wanted to make this morning was to Skylar Williams. I am so proud of him. He represents the future of our country on many levels and is a leader of integrity, vision, intelligence, and determination. I look forward to watching him change the world! It's been an honor to be on this journey with Skylar and Mark. I am proud of our support for one another and our united front. We grew together in our shared passion for meeting people's needs and fighting for accessible and affordable healthcare and housing. Together, we spoke out on the battles being fought to save our family farms and ranches. Together, we defined our individual traits and our shared values. Together. For this, I am profoundly grateful.
To Skylar and Mark, thank you.
Pictured with me is a new friend from Choteau, MT. While in Choteau, I stood with Leah as she wept for our country. I held her as she shed tears for the children who have died from gun violence, the potential overturning of Roe v. Wade, and the political division pitting American against American as if we were each others enemy. Leah recited dates to me of times in history when the political parties worked together to better the lives of Americans in need. She talked at length of her love for her community and what she had lived through to gain equal value under the law as a female. She shared how that equality helped women build their communities and finance social programs that helped the most vulnerable. And she wept as she reflected on the fear she now felt.
I understand this fear. I have felt it too, Leah.
We often use the word *fight* when talking about social or political change. Two distinct thoughts have become clear to me on this political journey in regard to the word *fight*.
1\. We fight FOR something good when it is hard to achieve. This type of fight tests our will, our determination, our values, our willingness to sacrifice, and the core of what we stand for. This type of fight brings growth, strength to our nation, and builds our value as a whole.
2\. We fight AGAINST something that attempts to reduce our power or control. With this meaning, I am referring to manipulation of facts, outright lies, and the demeaning of our fellow Americans for personal gain. This type of fight weakens our country, increases our division, and relishes in creating strife.
My aim, goal, and fight going forward is that we, as a country, work TOGETHER to build up one another, support our democracy, and grow our common good. May we be all that we can be when we work TOGETHER.
And may we hold on to, learn from, and believe in the love all of the Leahs have for our country.
Thank you, Montana. I believe in you.

When I was at the UN, I saw the truth about our enemies: _they’ll do ANYTHING to undermine America._ Terrorists, dictators, and communists don’t play by the rules. name: Admiral Mike Franken
subject: My answer to Fox News? I pulled the plug.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/14137?t=6&akid=3041%2E878179%2ED5vlfg) Hello,

As bombs began raining down on Ukrainian cities, Donald Trump called into Fox News to blame - you guessed it - Joe Biden and Hillary Clinton.

As Russian tanks began pouring over the Ukrainian border, Fox News host Laura Ingraham had the gall to call Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky "pathetic."

And if you tune into Tucker Carlson these days, you'll see a show that might as well have been written and produced by Russian state media. **Fox News showcases the chasm between traditional GOP normative behavior and the fringe-right cabal now headed by Donald J. Trump.**

As the commander of military forces in East Africa, I asked the American Forces Network to replace Fox News during meal hours for troops. Why? Because they were harmful to America's outreach overseas. They put our troops in jeopardy and made my job harder.

Without Fox News, Trump would have only ever been a bungling celebrity who foolishly and laughably ran for president.

Real-time reckoning of lies needs real-time litigation. There is such a thing as gross distortions of fact and purveyors of such must pay a debilitating price. **My answer to Fox when I was an admiral in the U.S. Navy? I pulled the plug.**

When I defeat Chuck Grassley and turn Iowa blue this November, I will be the most senior military person ever elected to the United States Senate. And I think it's about time we had more people in leadership who understand the true costs of war and media manipulation of facts, commonly called disinformation.

The polls show we can win. The pundits say we must win. And with your help today, we can fight back against McConnell's Super PAC lies and protect our Democratic majority in the Senate.

**We 've set a goal of raising another $100,000 before midnight, but right now, we're still short. If we're going to defeat Chuck Grassley and turn Iowa blue, I'm counting on grassroots donors like you to give now:** [**Please, will you split a donation of $5 or more right now between my campaign and Voter Protection Project - whatever you can afford before midnight tonight - to help me defeat Chuck Grassley, turn Iowa blue, and protect our Democratic Senate majority?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/14137?t=7&akid=3041%2E878179%2ED5vlfg) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Mike Franken and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/14138?t=8&akid=3041%2E878179%2ED5vlfg)
---

[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/14140?t=10&akid=3041%2E878179%2ED5vlfg)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/14141?t=11&akid=3041%2E878179%2ED5vlfg)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/14137?t=12&akid=3041%2E878179%2ED5vlfg)
Fox News' propaganda cannot go unanswered. But it takes significant funding to run a full-scale campaign and take on all of Grassley's and McConnell's lies.

I'm not taking a dime of corporate PAC money, so whatever you can give today will go a long way.

I am so thankful to have you on the team,

Mike Franken, VADM, U.S. Navy (ret.)

name: Alex Padilla for California
subject: The choice could not be more clear
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
body:
#

After yesterday’s primary, this California Senate race is down to Alex Padilla and Mark Meuser. And frankly, the choice could not be more clear.
As California Secretary of State, Alex expanded access to the ballot through reforms like automatic voter registration and the Voter’s Choice Act, which offered voters more options and flexibility in when, where, and how to vote including vote-by-mail and in-person early voting.
And in the Senate, Alex has been fighting for pro-democracy legislation like the Freedom to Vote Act and the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act. And when Republican obstruction blocked both bills, Alex was one of the first to call for the elimination of the filibuster.
Meanwhile, Mark Meuser _sued_ Alex over California’s program to automatically register driver’s license applicants as voters. He’s also come out in support of purging voter rolls, questioned the results of the 2020 election, and has tweeted that Donald Trump is right about voter fraud.
Meuser is also anti-choice, calling _Roe v. Wade_ “a bad constitutional decision,” and he opposes gun control. When asked about mass shootings he blamed video games, and he’s against expanded background checks for would-be gun buyers.
Yes, his views are way out of line with California, but we cannot afford to underestimate him. He's coming into this race with the full support — and financial resources — of the California GOP.
Just like they spent millions of dollars on the failed right-wing Recall attempt against Governor Newsom, they are willing to spend millions of dollars coming after Alex.
**So please:**
[**Make a donation today to become a General Election Founding Donor to Alex Padilla. We are running an aggressive campaign all across California because we know how important it is to hold this seat, but we need your support in order to hit the ground running.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-june22.3xful1&refcode=em220608-1-30&t=1&akid=843%2E159979%2E6UE_cd)

Thank you!
Team Padilla

subject: AANHPI Heritage Month and Adelante Launch
body:
| | | |
---
| | |
---
| Dear Friends,

Thank you all for joining us in celebrating Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander Heritage Month over the past few weeks! Throughout the history of our nation, AANHPI people have contributed to the rich culture and accomplishments of our country. To commemorate this heritage, the DNC AAPI Caucus presented “AAPI Rising,” a perfect end cap celebration to the month on Monday, May 31st. If you missed the event live, don’t worry! You can find the entire event at the link below. In addition to celebrating the AANHPI community, the month of May also brought about the launch of our Latino Signature Outreach Program, Adelante. This was kicked off by a call with several key stakeholders in the Latino community and continued with several events in Orlando and Miami, Florida, as part of the DNC’s Democrats for the People tour. This is just one of the Coalitions and Community Engagement Team’s array of Signature Outreach Programs. These programs will continue to build long standing relationships and deeper engagement with traditionally underserved communities. These actions are just the beginning of a Summer of outreach over at the DNC! Over the next few weeks, we will also see a number of Pride events, a Juneteenth event and so much more. Thank you all for staying engaged and active in our programming.
Best,
Brencia Berry
Director of Coalitions and Community Engagement
Democratic National Committee
---
|
---
|
---
| **The DNC AAPI Caucus presents AAPI Rising** The Democratic National Committee and the DNC AAPI Caucus hosted the virtual AAPI Rising celebration to celebrate the accomplishments of the Asian American, Native Hawaiian and Pacific Islander (AANHPI) community, and discuss how the Biden administration and Democrats are delivering for them. The celebration featured special appearances from Second Gentleman Douglas Emhoff, DNC Chair Jaime Harrison, Senator Tammy Duckworth, DNC AAPI Caucus Chair Bel Leong-Hong, and numerous other members of Congress, celebrities, and many more. Click on the button below to watch! You can also see pictures from the event below.
---
| [Watch AAPI Rising](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=f9acafbbdc&e=d6c5c7d7ec "Watch AAPI Rising")
---
|
---
---
|
---
---
|
---
|
---
| **_Adelante_ Launch**
DNC Latino Coalitions Director Michelle Villegas Tapia is launching and will direct Adelante’s programming across the country, including direct voter contact and community events. In addition to the launch of Adelante, the DNC is [also announcing part of a seven-figure investment in paid media](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=07a96df14c&e=d6c5c7d7ec), kicking off with a round of Spanish-language print and radio ads. The ads tout the historic progress made under the leadership of President Joe Biden and congressional Democratic majorities. The DNC is already working in partnership with its sister committees to invest in Latino outreach and organizing in targeted coordinated campaigns, including in Arizona, Nevada, New Mexico, Florida, Texas, Wisconsin, and Pennsylvania. Adelante will build on the DNC’s Spanish-language and bilingual voter contact program, through which volunteers help provide states with dedicated Spanish-language outreach capacity focused on coalition building, voter registration, and mobilization.

To kick off the program on the ground, Democratic National Committee Chair Jaime Harrison traveled to Florida to host a roundtable with Puerto Rican community leaders at Cariños Cafe in Kissimmee. During the event, Chair Harrison and local leaders discussed Democrats’ work to reach out to and mobilize the Puerto Rican community.
---
|
---
---
|
---
|
---
| **Track to ‘22** The Democrats are introducing Track to '22, an eight-week virtual boot camp, to prepare you and other Democrats with the skills and resources to organize your community and to mobilize voters across the country ahead of the midterms. Sessions will be hosted virtually every Saturday and recordings will be available for those who are unable to attend in real-time. With less than 200 days from Election Day every phone call, text message, online conversation, and voter registered is critical. Sessions will deep dive into the building blocks of organizing, overview of advanced voter contact strategies, and community organizing skills you can take with you year over year. Track to ‘22 is for everyone, whether you're looking to get involved for the first time, sharpen your organizing chops, show up as a better grassroots activist in your community, or take on a leadership role.

body:
We’re just inches from reaching our TV Ad Fund goal.
#
Derek,
Yesterday, we launched our first General Election TV Ad Fund to help fight back against the attack ad that the GOP launched against me.
**In order to get on the air + reach as many voters as possible, we need to raise $75,000 by midnight tonight. We are so, so close, but I need your help.**
[**_Can you make a donation of $5 today to help us reach our goal + get our ads on the air?_**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220608-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220608-6143&refcode2=6143_434096_ki9ReE&akid=6143%2E434096%2Eki9ReE)
**[Donate to our TV Ad Fund »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220608-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220608-6143&refcode2=6143_434096_ki9ReE&akid=6143%2E434096%2Eki9ReE)**
ICYMI: The GOP dropped $2.3 million on an ad attacking us last week — _and that was before Dr. Oz was declared our official opponent._
Between the million$ of self-funding Dr. Oz can afford to do, as well as the corporate super PACs jumping in to support his campaign...not gonna lie, it makes me a little nervous. 😬
**We can’t afford to lose ground here.** That’s why I need your help to meet our $75,000 TV Ad Fund goal by midnight tonight.
[**_We are so close to being able to launch these ads across PA. Can you help us keep our powerful new ads on the air so our campaign can reach millions of voters?_**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220608-2?refcode=em20220608-6143&refcode2=6143_434096_ki9ReE&akid=6143%2E434096%2Eki9ReE)
**[Donate to our TV Ad Fund »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220608-2?refcode=em20220608-6143&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6143_434096_ki9ReE&akid=6143%2E434096%2Eki9ReE)**
Thanks for your help, Derek. Every single dollar we raise is going to be crucial to helping our campaign + its message reach every single community in PA.
More soon,
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

name: Beto for Texas
subject: re: Your assignment in Anderson County
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Beto for Texas
body:
Big announcement: we’re launching a 254 County Mobilization Plan.
#
The secret to winning in a state as big and diverse as Texas is to not to write anyone off. No county is too small, too Republican, or too _anything_ for us to compete for their votes. We need to go _everywhere_ and talk to _everyone_.
**That’s why we’re asking you to assist with our 254 County Mobilization Plan.**
To reach every single voter, we need a budget for organizing and advertising in each corner of Texas. And three weeks from now, we have a BIG state-mandated fundraising deadline. We’ll publicly report how much we’ve raised for the first time since February. We want to be able to say we’ve reached our fundraising goals to compete in each and every one of Texas’ 254 counties. That’s where you come in!
**We’ve assigned you to sponsor Anderson County in Texas.** More than 29,128 voters are registered there, and we’ve set a goal of raising $14,564.00 to fund our 254 County Mobilization plan in Anderson County. **Can Beto count on your help to reach Anderson County voters?** **⇢**[**Make a $25 donation to reach 50 voters in Anderson County.****
**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56132?refcode=ema20220608-193005&County=Anderson&Voters=29%2C128&t=7&akid=193005%2E444211%2EMK3s3J)**⇢**[**Make a $50 donation to reach 100 voters in Anderson County.****
**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56135?refcode=ema20220608-193005&County=Anderson&Voters=29%2C128&t=8&akid=193005%2E444211%2EMK3s3J)**⇢**[**Make a $100 donation to reach 200 voters in Anderson County.****
**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56136?refcode=ema20220608-193005&County=Anderson&Voters=29%2C128&t=9&akid=193005%2E444211%2EMK3s3J)**⇢**[**Make a $250 donation to reach 500 voters in Anderson County.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56137?refcode=ema20220608-193005&County=Anderson&Voters=29%2C128&t=10&akid=193005%2E444211%2EMK3s3J) **[Sponsor Anderson County»](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56131?refcode=ema20220608-193005&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&County=Anderson&Voters=29%2C128&t=11&akid=193005%2E444211%2EMK3s3J)**
---
It’s true that most Texans live in big cities and counties. But you cannot expect to win in a state like Texas if you write off the rural counties, which are so vital to the future of this state.
Because these places have voted reliably Republican over the last two decades, you’ve seen many state and national Democrats write them off. And because those Democrats stopped showing up, Republicans didn’t have to either. There was no competition for votes.
**Our 254 County Mobilization plan gives us a BIG edge.** You would be surprised at how many people will vote with us if given a chance to hear from our campaign. In counties where most people vote Republican, competing for votes will help us close the margins. And in counties that often vote Democrat, showing up and organizing will help us increase our margins.
**But the plan only works if we can raise enough money to organize, advertise and show up in all 254 counties.**[**Can you help us hit our fundraising goal for Anderson County before the June 30 Texas Ethics Commission deadline?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56131?refcode=ema20220608-193005&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&County=Anderson&Voters=29%2C128&t=12&akid=193005%2E444211%2EMK3s3J)
Thank you, for considering a donation to reach the 29,128 registered voters of Anderson County. That’s what a true grassroots campaign looks like. Talking to everyone, writing no one off. Competing for every vote.
Beto for Texas
**[Contribute»](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56131?refcode=ema20220608-193005&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&County=Anderson&Voters=29%2C128&t=13&akid=193005%2E444211%2EMK3s3J)**

| | | |
---
|
---
|
# Vote in the primary for a candidate who can win the general election
---
|
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
Electing a candidate in the primary should be done with a clear thought in mind: that your candidate can win in the fall.
For Congressional District 7, I am the only candidate who can win in the fall by facing down the Democrat Progressive Leftist machine. I will do it by appealing to Republicans, Democrats, and Independents by bringing positive solutions to the Progressives' contrived crises (inflation, energy policy, illegal immigration, crime, education, national security, etc.) while emphasizing that Congress has a duty to uphold the US Constitution and to put the American people first. Voters will also know that I speak on issues with authority backed by considerable experience.
In the runup to the general election, Democrats will unload a mountain of money and energy on winning any seat they can. Nothing will be held back. This is war.
Winning in the fall will require a candidate that shows command of a broad range of issues, demonstrates exemplary character and a moral compass grounded in Judeo-Christian principles, an unyielding commitment to the US Constitution, and who presents an inspiring vision for the future.
| | |
---|---
|
Furthermore, I will not cower in the face of pervasive Washington corruption. Instead, my focused and informed actions will restore trust in our government, one that has become self-serving and dangerously derelict in its duty.
I have been shaped by strong parents who instilled noble values, further developed with the ideals of the U.S. Military Academy at West Point whose watchwords are "Duty, Honor, Country", and tempered with service alongside courageous Americans on the battlefields of Iraq and Afghanistan. In the energy industry, I learned how sound energy policy is essential to the future of America and our national security. My experiences all over the world leading teams in difficult places to high achievement will guide me through the battle to be waged against the Progressives in the fall.
The candidate who wins the election must be able to not only win the race but most importantly do the job. It seems self-evident, but many candidates get into office and then ask themselves, "now what?"
Only bringing ideas or grand plans, or speaking loudly from the bully pulpit, are not qualifications for being a Congressperson.
| | |
---|---
|
The challenge of changing DC is significant, and our elected officials must have exceptional qualities, and extraordinary character, to make positive changes. I not only have ideas that will work, but the experience to implement them, to solve the greatest problems of our generation with a willingness to build coalitions with like-minded members who will uphold the US Constitution and put this country first. I will hit the ground running on day one and take a back seat to no one, regardless of tenure.
None of the other candidates in this race have my breadth of experience or firsthand knowledge of how to address the many challenges facing us today.
Vote for me in the primary June 28th and the general election November 8th

I will take this seat for Colorado and serve you in DC.
|

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being a net exporter of natural gas and becoming energy independent. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

I want to say an immense **thank you** to everyone who made this win happen. To the volunteers who knocked on doors and called voters, the thousands of donors who chipped in to fund this campaign, and everyone who trusted me with your vote. Thank you — I’ll work every day to keep earning it.
And to my brilliant wife Yasmine and our two boys — thank you for the sacrifices you’ve each made these past months, and for believing in me. You inspire me every day to keep going.
With love,
Dr. Kermit Jones

According to a WSJ poll out last week, “ _**support for a Republican candidate rose to 27% among black voters, up from 12% in November**_.”

If Republicans end up getting even close to 27% of the black vote in 2022, Dems will have to do some serious introspection.

As a first-generation American and son of Haitian immigrants, I can attest to this: **America the beautiful doesn’t care about the color of one’s skin**. name: CharlesBooker.org
subject: How we’re going to win this race
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
Rand knows that his seat has never been so vulnerable and that our progressive movement is rising.
#
Rand is scared, Peter.
Ever since Charles became the first Black Kentuckian to win the Democratic primary, **Rand knows that his seat has never been so vulnerable and that our progressive movement is rising.**
More Kentuckians than ever before recognize the fact that we deserve better and we have the power to change that. If we keep growing this momentum, we can replace Rand with a leader who’s boldly fighting for people-first solutions like Medicare for All and a Green New Deal.
Charles may not be the favorite choice of the establishment or the powerful groups that control D.C. **— but he’s by far the favorite choice of the people and that’s what matters.**
That’s why we’re reaching out to ask: [**Will you add your name right now and give your personal endorsement for Charles? People power is how we’re going to win this race and it’s critical we show our support now for the bold, progressive movement we’re building.**](https://act.charlesbooker.org/sign/personal-endorsement-2022-june/?source=em20220608&t=1&akid=2039%2E346206%2EGk_-qj)
**[ENDORSE OUR CAMPAIGN →](https://act.charlesbooker.org/sign/personal-endorsement-2022-june/?source=em20220608&t=2&akid=2039%2E346206%2EGk_-qj)**
Some pundits think Kentucky is not winnable.
**_We call BS._** We are building the largest grassroots movement this state has ever seen, and we will make history in November.
**Everywhere you go, folks agree on the same thing: it’s time for change.**
We deserve a health care system that looks at us like human beings _, and not potential profits._
We deserve leaders who care more about saving lives _than pleasing their friends in the gun lobby._
We deserve Senators who prioritize our interests and needs, _not their own political agendas._
From our recent primary win, to the historic victories that were made across the south in 2020 — there’s evidence all around us that we can turn Kentucky blue.
**But we need to know first who’s with us in this fight:**[**Will you add your name today and give your personal endorsement for our campaign? We want to collect a record number of personal endorsements from everyday folks to show off the power of our grassroots campaign.**](https://act.charlesbooker.org/sign/personal-endorsement-2022-june/?source=em20220608&t=3&akid=2039%2E346206%2EGk_-qj)
**[ENDORSE OUR CAMPAIGN →](https://act.charlesbooker.org/sign/personal-endorsement-2022-june/?source=em20220608&t=4&akid=2039%2E346206%2EGk_-qj)**
Thank you for your support,
Team Booker

Fellow Conservative: The _New York Times_ just learned about CPI’s **Election Integrity Network** and the statewide training conferences we have been leading across the country this year.
And after seeing Cleta Mitchell leading just one Summit meeting, they are in full-out panic mode!
Sunday, they published a _3,500-word expose_ on our efforts to:
* Organize volunteers (_GASP!_),
* Teach them how elections work (_SHUDDER!_),
* Train them to be civil and gracious (_HOW DARE WE!_), and
* Show them how to ensure fair elections.

_**THE HORROR!**_
The ridiculous article was the latest in a series of insinuating, dishonest hit pieces against Cleta, CPI, and conservatives. Whenever conservatives act, the media gets scared.
Well... they should be.
For generations, the media, the deep state, and liberal poll workers had exclusive power over election information in this country. The lesson Americans learned in 2020: NEVER AGAIN.
**[Help end election fraud today: Support CPI](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=4066535965c84d29bab1130cb897c435&_e=Liz5TQ2t5cg4Lb-tH_Xi3Vb5Gyeg8g52XvDbe1Aa3fWrJJDT_Uywrpshwwl2MO9Y8zDebQVfrgfmoxtrh3Ue4mzWrozCgn0eZE5MsY2mUUR_ONjdhoekNVDuALXBgu9B-p3ua8eMLmN_l1n6yAXpRsKZw5u-afs39LCiWxOYo_KJMdQOHPGOlfBU2GyLuk0CQn_UdlRZmDThpFptUSNFJNFaE5SAIdGoVQ756V80Q8lXpKqTyBnaeOHV_4UW8iXjP74i30lfvQKpBl01AWUWJItlq0zQvZ72ADEAoZzT83WMyl3c3Adk8VKvVo6NEAlJtH9eqIlJeKv3DMvUtR-KETFmh22HFm4F7F7u4yuPoxk%3D)**
The public wants free and fair elections, and the Election Integrity Network is working every day to ensure we have them.
Liberal pundits are outraged that we're teaching activists exactly how the system works and how to prevent it from being corrupted. We teach citizens how to regain control over and confidence in their elections – and the Left calls that “intimidation.”
Hogwash.
They know what this is really about. They know the corners they have cut, the games they play with the rules, and with our votes. And we’re putting a stop to it.
We’re going to be holding Election Integrity Summits in numerous states between now and November. But we can’t do it without you.
**[Support CPI and the Election Integrity Network!](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=4066535965c84d29bab1130cb897c435&_e=Liz5TQ2t5cg4Lb-tH_Xi3Vb5Gyeg8g52XvDbe1Aa3fWrJJDT_Uywrpshwwl2MO9Y8zDebQVfrgfmoxtrh3Ue4mzWrozCgn0eZE5MsY2mUUR_ONjdhoekNVDuALXBgu9B-p3ua8eMLmN_l1n6yAXpRjpoTfTISwCASbD8EUUJEaFSBW8j8nCWqxEjQ3oG6PU2FImUSyooQOMVdySlEEs4_3dhy0O8AOS7jr9l3Gyx0ugtrNXaW87GSzyxe044j9hZL3NKStYsN38rfXSg9Jz1A9a2GVx--dAMJEFO1PHj_JMmifhMQGLAyiL3a_wFdNxfJbDdcp1l0IFOcR4dZOzoD7rSAjMmA7vr2z9CLEoI5os%3D)**
We need your help to take this work to the next level. Voting season is in full swing, and the most important mid-term elections of our lives are only _MONTHS AWAY!_
There is no time to lose – and no organization working harder to protect the integrity of the voting booth and the ballot box than CPI’s Election Integrity Network.
If the liberals at the N _ew York Times_ are shaking in their boots, you know we’re doing something right!
Thank you for considering this request and doing so much to help fight for America's future. For Freedom,

subject: California, thank you.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nathan Hochman for Attorney General 2022
body:
Although ballots are still being counted and the outcome is unclear, we feel good about where things are at. Thank you for your support and vote.

Hi
Peter
,

I can't begin to thank you enough. When this campaign began, I was understandably looked at as a long shot. Solid resume but could he build a campaign on a compelling message, raise enough money, and bring in high-level endorsements to convince hundreds of thousands of people to vote for him? Over a year ago, I set out to do just that and since then have built an army of incredible supporters like yourself who have helped me raise over $2 million; attract a former governor, Congress members, California State legislators, DAs and law enforcement, as well as the California Republican Party, to endorse me; and met with thousands of voters around the state talking to them about my common-sense, pragmatic solutions to the problems plaguing California

It was your support, contributions, and dedication to improving our state that allowed us to make it all happen.

While ballots are still being counted, we feel good about the numbers we are seeing. This is a close race, and we won't know the outcome definitively for several more days, but things are moving in the right direction, and we seem to be headed towards the general election in November.

Last night, all across California, voters sent a strong message, demanding the restoration of their safety and security. That message particularly resonated in San Francisco where one of the "Let Em' Go Guys," Chesa Boudin, was decisively recalled by voters from his position as the District Attorney of San Francisco.

I strongly believe that the other two "Let Em' Go Guys," LA DA George Gascon and AG Rob Bonta, are going to be the next to lose their jobs.

Thank you again for being with us on this journey. We will be sure to keep you updated as the votes are counted.

Sincerely,

Nathan

Take a look at the panicked email they sent: The Democrats are on a roll with their fundraising. Their supporters understand what's at stake - control of the U.S. Senate and the fate of the Biden-Schumer-Pelosi agenda. In Georgia, we're running against the #1 fundraising senator in the country who already has $23 million in his campaign war chest. Our campaign is being aggressive in our fundraising, but we're behind our June goal - by a significant amount. We hate writing emails like this 5 months from Election Day, but we must hit every fundraising goal along the way if we're going to have the necessary funds to win in November. The last thing that we want is for complacency to set in. While some conservatives believe we have the wind at our back, that doesn't translate into automatic victory in November. Far from it. We must block, tackle, and excel at the basics of campaigning - like raising money, organizing volunteers, and registering voters - to win.
